pli-tv-kd1:1.1.1: I. Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Uruvelāyaṃ viharati najjā Nerañjarāya tīre bodhirukkhamūle paṭhamābhisambuddho.
pli-tv-kd1:1.1.2: atha kho bhagavā bodhirukkhamūle sattāhaṃ ekapallaṅkena nisīdi vimuttisukhapaṭisaṃvedī. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:1.2.1: atha kho bhagavā rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ paṭiccasamuppādaṃ anulomapaṭilomaṃ manas' ākāsi:
pli-tv-kd1:1.2.2: avijjāpaccayā saṃkhārā, saṃkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti.
pli-tv-kd1:1.2.3: evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:1.2.4: avijjāya tv eva asesavirāganirodhā saṃkhāranirodho, saṃkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho, viññāṇanirodhā nāmarūpanirodho, nāmarūpanirodhā saḷāyatananirodho, saḷāyatananirodhā phassanirodho, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho, vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho, taṇhānirodhā upādānanirodho, upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti.
pli-tv-kd1:1.2.5: evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:1.3.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd1:1.4.1: atha kho bhagavā rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ paṭiccasamuppādaṃ anulomapaṭilomaṃ manas' ākāsi:
pli-tv-kd1:1.4.2: avijjāpaccayā saṃkhārā, saṃkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ --la--
pli-tv-kd1:1.4.3: evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti --pa--
pli-tv-kd1:1.5.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd1:1.6.1: atha kho bhagavā rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paṭiccasamuppādaṃ anulomapaṭilomaṃ manas' ākāsi:
pli-tv-kd1:1.6.3: evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti --pa--
pli-tv-kd1:1.7.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd1:2.1.1: atha kho bhagavā sattāhassa accayena tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhahitvā bodhirukkhamūlā yena Ajapālanigrodho ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Ajapālanigrodharukkhamūle sattāhaṃ ekapallaṅkena nisīdi vimuttisukhapaṭisaṃvedī. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:2.2.1: atha kho aññataro huhuṅkajātiko brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami,
pli-tv-kd1:2.2.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-kd1:2.2.4: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:2.2.5: kittāvatā nu kho bho Gotama brāhmaṇo hoti katame ca pana brāhmaṇakaraṇā dhammā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:2.3.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd1:2.3.6: yass' ussadā n' atthi kuhiñci loke 'ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:3.1.1: atha kho bhagavā sattāhassa accayena tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhahitvā Ajapālanigrodhamūlā yena Mucalindo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Mucalindamūle sattāhaṃ ekapallaṅkena nisīdi vimuttisukhapaṭisaṃvedī. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:3.2.1: tena kho pana samayena mahāakālamegho udapādi sattāhavaddalikā sītavātaduddinī.
pli-tv-kd1:3.2.2: atha kho Mucalindo nāgarājā sakabhavanā nikkhamitvā bhagavato kāyaṃ sattakkhattuṃ bhogehi parikkhipitvā upari muddhani mahantaṃ phaṇaṃ karitvā aṭṭhāsi:
pli-tv-kd1:3.2.3: mā bhagavantaṃ sītaṃ, mā bhagavantaṃ uṇhaṃ, mā bhagavantaṃ ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphasso 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:3.3.1: atha kho Mucalindo nāgarājā sattāhassa accayena viddhaṃ vigatavalāhakaṃ devaṃ viditvā bhagavato kāyā bhoge viniveṭhetvā sakavaṇṇaṃ paṭisaṃharitvā māṇavakavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā bhagavato purato aṭṭhāsi añjaliko bhagavantaṃ namassamāno. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:3.3.2: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd1:4.1.1: atha kho bhagavā sattāhassa accayena tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhahitvā Mucalindamūlā yena Rājāyatanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Rājāyatanamūle sattāhaṃ ekapallaṅkena nisīdi vimuttisukhapaṭisaṃvedī. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:4.2.1: tena kho pana samayena Tapussabhallikā vāṇijā Ukkalā taṃ desaṃ addhānamaggapaṭipannā honti.
pli-tv-kd1:4.2.2: atha kho Tapussabhallikānaṃ vāṇijānaṃ ñāti sālohitā devatā Tapussabhallike vāṇije etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:4.2.3: ayaṃ mārisā bhagavā Rājāyatanamūle viharati paṭhamābhisambuddho,
pli-tv-kd1:4.2.4: gacchatha taṃ bhagavantaṃ manthena ca madhupiṇḍikāya ca paṭimānetha,
pli-tv-kd1:4.2.5: taṃ vo bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:4.3.1: atha kho Tapussabhallikā vāṇijā manthañ ca madhupiṇḍikañ ca ādāya yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu,
pli-tv-kd1:4.3.2: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho Tapussabhallikā vāṇijā bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:4.3.3: paṭigaṇhātu no bhante bhagavā manthañ ca madhupiṇḍikañ ca yaṃ amhākaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā 'ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:4.4.3: kimhi nu kho ahaṃ paṭigaṇheyyaṃ manthañ ca madhupiṇḍikañ cā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:4.4.4: atha kho cattāro Mahārājāno bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya catuddisā cattāro selamaye patte bhagavato upanāmesuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:4.4.5: idha bhante bhagavā paṭigaṇhātu manthañ ca madhupiṇḍikañ cā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:4.4.6: paṭiggahesi bhagavā paccagghe selamaye patte manthañ ca madhupiṇḍikañ ca paṭiggahetvā ca paribhuñji. ||4||
pli-tv-kd1:4.5.1: atha kho Tapussabhallikā vāṇijā bhagavantaṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ viditvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:4.5.2: ete mayaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañ ca, upāsake no bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupete saraṇaṃ gate 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:4.5.3: teva loke paṭhamaṃ upāsakā ahesuṃ dvevācikā. ||5||
pli-tv-kd1:5.1.1: atha kho bhagavā sattāhassa accayena tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhahitvā Rājāyatanamūlā yena Ajapālanigrodho ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā
pli-tv-kd1:5.2.1: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd1:5.2.2: adhigato kho my āyaṃ dhammo gambhīro duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo.
pli-tv-kd1:5.2.3: ālayarāmā kho panāyaṃ pajā ālayaratā ālayasammuditā.
pli-tv-kd1:5.2.4: ālayarāmāya kho pana pajāya ālayaratāya ālayasammuditāya duddasaṃ idaṃ ṭhānaṃ yad idaṃ idappaccayatā paṭiccasamuppādo,
pli-tv-kd1:5.2.5: idam pi kho ṭhānaṃ sududdasaṃ yad idaṃ sabbasaṃkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:5.2.6: ahañ ceva kho pana dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ pare ca me na ājāneyyuṃ, so mam' assa kilamatho, sā mam' assa vihesā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:5.3.1: api 'ssu bhagavantaṃ imā anacchariyā gāthāyo paṭibhaṃsu pubbe assutapubbā:
pli-tv-kd1:5.4.1: iti ha bhagavato paṭisañcikkhato appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati no dhammadesanāya.
pli-tv-kd1:5.4.2: atha kho Brahmuno Sahampatissa bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:5.4.3: nassati vata bho loko, vinassati vata bho loko, yatra hi nāma tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati no dhammadesanāyā 'ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd1:5.5.1: atha kho Brahmā Sahampati, seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Brahmaloke antarahito bhagavato purato pāturahosi. ||5||
pli-tv-kd1:5.6.1: atha kho Brahmā Sahampati ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā dakkhiṇañ jānumaṇḍalaṃ paṭhaviyaṃ nihantvā yena bhagavā ten' añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:5.6.2: desetu bhante bhagavā dhammaṃ, desetu sugato dhammaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:5.6.3: santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti, bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro 'ti. ||6||
pli-tv-kd1:5.7.1: idaṃ avoca Brahmā Sahampati, idaṃ vatvā athāparaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:5.8.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā Brahmānaṃ Sahampatiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:5.8.3: adhigato kho my āyaṃ dhammo gambhīro duddaso duranubodho . . .
pli-tv-kd1:5.8.8: api 'ssu maṃ Brahme imā anacchariyā gāthāyo paṭibhaṃsu pubbe me assutapubbā . . .
pli-tv-kd1:5.8.17: iti ha me Brahme paṭisañcikkhato appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati no dhammadesanāyā 'ti. ||8||
pli-tv-kd1:5.9.1: dutiyam pi kho Brahmā Sahampati bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:5.9.19: dutiyam pi kho bhagavā Brahmānaṃ Sahampatiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:5.9.20: mayham pi kho Brahme etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:5.9.21: adhigato kho my āyaṃ dhammo gambhīro duddaso duranubodho . . .
pli-tv-kd1:5.9.26: api 'ssu maṃ Brahme imā anacchariyā gāthāyo paṭibhaṃsu pubbe me assutapubbā . . .
pli-tv-kd1:5.9.35: iti ha me Brahme paṭisañcikkhato appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati no dhammadesanāyā 'ti. ||9||
pli-tv-kd1:5.9.36: tatiyam pi kho Brahmā Sahampati bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:5.10.1: atha kho bhagavā Brahmuno ca ajjhesanaṃ viditvā sattesu ca kāruññataṃ paṭicca buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokesi.
pli-tv-kd1:5.11.1: addasa kho bhagavā buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante. ||10||
pli-tv-kd1:5.11.2: seyyathāpi nāma uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udakānuggatāni antonimuggaposīni, appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni samodakaṇ ṭhitāni, appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udakā accuggamma ṭhitāni anupalittāni udakena, ||11||
pli-tv-kd1:5.11.3: evam eva bhagavā buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento addasa satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante,
pli-tv-kd1:5.13.2: katāvakāso kho 'mhi bhagavatā dhammadesanāyā 'ti bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyi. ||13||
pli-tv-kd1:6.1.2: kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:6.1.3: ko imaṃ dhammaṃ khippam eva ājānissatīti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.1.5: ayaṃ kho Āḷāro Kālāmo paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī dīgharattaṃ apparajakkhajātiko.
pli-tv-kd1:6.1.6: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ Āḷārassa Kālāmassa paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, so imaṃ dhammaṃ khippam eva ājānissatīti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:6.2.1: atha kho antarahitā devatā bhagavato ārocesi: sattāhakālaṃkato bhante Āḷāro Kālāmo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.2.2: bhagavato pi kho ñāṇaṃ udapādi sattāhakālaṃ kato Āḷāro Kālāmo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.2.5: sace hi so imaṃ dhammaṃ suṇeyya, khippam eva ājāneyyā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:6.3.2: kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:6.3.3: ko imaṃ dhammaṃ khippam eva ājānissatīti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.3.5: ayaṃ kho Uddako Rāmaputto paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī dīgharattaṃ apparajakkhajātiko.
pli-tv-kd1:6.3.6: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ Uddakassa Rāmaputtassa paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, so imaṃ dhammaṃ khippam eva ājānissatīti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:6.4.1: atha kho antarahitā devatā bhagavato ārocesi: abhidosakālaṃkato bhante Uddako Rāmaputto 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.4.2: bhagavato pi kho ñāṇaṃ udapādi abhidosakālaṃkato Uddako Rāmaputto 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.4.5: sace hi so imaṃ dhammaṃ suṇeyya, khippam eva ājāneyyā 'ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd1:6.5.2: kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:6.5.3: ko imaṃ dhammaṃ khippam eva ājānissatīti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.5.5: bahūpakārā kho 'me pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū, ye maṃ padhānapahitattaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:6.6.1: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ pañcavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyan ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd1:6.6.3: kahaṃ nu kho etarahi pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū viharantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.6.4: addasa kho bhagavā dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena pañcavaggiye bhikkhū Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharante Isipatane migadāye.
pli-tv-kd1:6.6.5: atha kho bhagavā Uruvelāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Bārāṇasī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi. ||6||
pli-tv-kd1:6.7.1: addasa kho Upako ājīviko bhagavantaṃ antarā ca Gayaṃ antarā ca bodhiṃ addhānamaggapaṭipannaṃ, disvāna bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:6.7.2: vippasannāni kho te āvuso indriyāni, parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto.
pli-tv-kd1:6.8.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā Upakaṃ ājīvikaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi:
pli-tv-kd1:6.9.1: yathā kho tvaṃ āvuso paṭijānāsi arah' asi anantajino 'ti:
pli-tv-kd1:6.9.6: evaṃ vutte Upako ājīviko hupeyya āvuso 'ti vatvā sīsaṃ okampetvā ummaggaṃ gahetvā pakkāmi. ||9||
pli-tv-kd1:6.10.1: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Bārāṇasī Isipatanamigadāyo yena pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-kd1:6.10.2: addasaṃsu kho pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:6.10.4: ayaṃ āvuso samaṇo Gotamo āgacchati bāhulliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya.
pli-tv-kd1:6.10.5: so n' eva abhivādetabbo na paccuṭṭhātabbo nāssa pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:6.10.6: api ca kho āsanaṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ, sace ākaṅkhissati nisīdissatīti. ||10||
pli-tv-kd1:6.11.1: yathā-yathā kho bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū upasaṃkamati, tathā-tathā te pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū sakāya katikāya
pli-tv-kd1:6.11.2: asaṇṭhahantā bhagavantaṃ paccuggantvā eko bhagavato pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesi, eko āsanaṃ paññāpesi, eko pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.11.5: api 'ssu bhagavantaṃ nāmena ca āvusovādena ca samudācaranti. ||11||
pli-tv-kd1:6.12.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:6.12.2: mā bhikkhave tathāgataṃ nāmena ca āvusovādena ca samudācaratha.
pli-tv-kd1:6.12.3: arahaṃ bhikkhave tathāgato sammāsambuddho. odahatha bhikkhave sotaṃ, amataṃ adhigataṃ, ahaṃ anusāsāmi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.12.4: yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamānā na cirass' eva
pli-tv-kd1:6.12.5: yass' atthāya kulaputtā sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tad anuttaraṃ
pli-tv-kd1:6.12.6: brahmacariyapariyosānam diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā 'ti. ||12||
pli-tv-kd1:6.13.1: evaṃ vutte pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:6.13.2: tāya pi kho tvaṃ āvuso Gotama cariyāya tāya paṭipadāya tāya dukkarakārikāya n' ev' ajjhagā uttarimanussadhammaṃ alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ, kim pana tvaṃ etarahi bāhulliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya adhigamissasi uttarimanussadhammaṃ alamariyañāṇadassanavisesan ti. ||13||
pli-tv-kd1:6.14.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:6.14.2: na bhikkhave tathāgato bāhulliko, na padhānavibbhanto, na āvatto bāhullāya.
pli-tv-kd1:6.14.4: odahatha bhikkhave sotaṃ, amataṃ adhigataṃ, ahaṃ anusāsāmi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.14.5: yathānusiṭṭham tathā paṭipajjamānā na cirass' eva
pli-tv-kd1:6.14.6: yass' atthāya kulaputtā sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tad anuttaraṃ
pli-tv-kd1:6.14.7: brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā 'ti. ||14||
pli-tv-kd1:6.15.1: dutiyam pi kho pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ --pa--,
pli-tv-kd1:6.15.2: dutiyam pi kho bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etad avoca --pa--,
pli-tv-kd1:6.15.3: tatiyam pi kho pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:6.15.4: tāya pi kho tvaṃ āvuso Gotama cariyāya tāya paṭipadāya . . . alamariyañāṇadassanavisesan ti. ||15||
pli-tv-kd1:6.16.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:6.16.2: abhijānātha me no tumhe bhikkhave ito pubbe evarūpaṃ bhāsitaṃ etan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.16.8: asakkhi kho bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū saññāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:6.16.9: atha kho pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ puna sussūsiṃsu sotaṃ odahiṃsu aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhāpesuṃ. ||16||
pli-tv-kd1:6.17.1: atha kho bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:6.17.2: dve 'me bhikkhave antā pabbajitena na sevitabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:6.17.4: yo cāyaṃ kāmesu kāmasukhallikānuyogo hīno gammo pothujjaniko anariyo anatthasaṃhito, yo cāyaṃ attakilamathānuyogo dukkho anariyo anatthasaṃhito,
pli-tv-kd1:6.17.5: ete kho bhikkhave ubho ante anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati. ||17||
pli-tv-kd1:6.18.1: katamā ca sā bhikkhave majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
pli-tv-kd1:6.18.2: ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:6.18.3: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṃkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.18.4: ayaṃ kho sā bhikkhave majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati. ||18||
pli-tv-kd1:6.19.1: idaṃ kho pana bhikkhave dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:6.19.2: jāti pi dukkhā, jarāpi dukkhā, vyādhi pi dukkhā, maraṇam pi dukkhaṃ, appiyehi sampayogo dukkho, piyehi vippayogo dukkho, yam p' icchaṃ na labhati tam pi dukkhaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:6.20.1: idaṃ kho pana bhikkhave dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:6.20.2: yāyaṃ taṇhā ponobbhavikā nandirāgasahagatā tatratatrābhinandinī, seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:6.21.1: idaṃ kho pana bhikkhave dukkhanirodhaṃ ariyasaccam,
pli-tv-kd1:6.21.2: yo tassā yeva taṇhāya asesavirāganirodho cāgo paṭinissaggo mutti anālayo. ||21||
pli-tv-kd1:6.22.1: idaṃ kho pana bhikkhave dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:6.22.2: ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:6.23.1: idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccan ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.23.2: taṃ kho pan' idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ pariññeyyan ti me bhikkhave
pli-tv-kd1:6.23.3: --la-- pariññātan ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi. ||23||
pli-tv-kd1:6.24.1: idaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccan ti me bhikkhave . . . āloko udapādi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.24.2: taṃ kho pan' idaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ pahātabban ti me bhikkhave
pli-tv-kd1:6.24.3: --la-- pahīnan ti me bhikkhave . . . āloko udapādi. ||24||
pli-tv-kd1:6.25.1: idaṃ dukkhanirodhaṃ ariyasaccan ti me bhikkhave . . . āloko udapādi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.25.2: taṃ kho pan' idaṃ dukkhanirodhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ sacchikātabban ti me bhikkhave
pli-tv-kd1:6.25.3: --la-- sacchikatan ti me bhikkhave . . . āloko udapādi. ||25||
pli-tv-kd1:6.26.1: idaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccan ti me bhikkhave . . . āloko udapādi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.26.2: taṃ kho pan' idaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ bhāvetabban ti me bhikkhave --
pli-tv-kd1:6.26.3: la -bhāvitan ti me bhikkhave . . . āloko udapādi. ||26||
pli-tv-kd1:6.27.1: yāva kīvañ ca me bhikkhave imesu catusu ariyasaccesu evaṃ tiparivaṭṭaṃ dvādasākāraṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ na suvisuddhaṃ ahosi, n' eva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho 'ti paccaññāsiṃ. ||27||
pli-tv-kd1:6.28.1: yato ca kho me bhikkhave imesu catusu ariyasaccesu evaṃ tiparivaṭṭaṃ dvādasākāraṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ ahosi, athāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho 'ti paccaññāsiṃ. ||28||
pli-tv-kd1:6.29.1: ñāṇañ ca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi:
pli-tv-kd1:6.29.2: akuppā me cetovimutti, ayaṃ antimā jāti, n' atthi dāni punabbhavo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.29.3: idaṃ avoca bhagavā, attamanā pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandanti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.29.4: imasmiñ ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne āyasmato Koṇḍaññassa virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
pli-tv-kd1:6.29.5: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman ti. ||29||
pli-tv-kd1:6.30.1: pavattite ca bhagavatā dhammacakke bhummā devā saddaṃ anussāvesuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:6.30.2: evaṃ bhagavatā Bārāṇasiyaṃ Isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā Mārena vā Brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmin ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.30.3: bhummānaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā Cātumahārājikā devā saddaṃ anussāvesuṃ --la--
pli-tv-kd1:6.30.4: Cātumahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā Tāvatiṃsā devā --la--
pli-tv-kd1:6.30.10: evaṃ bhagavatā Bārāṇasiyaṃ Isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā Mārena vā Brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmin ti. ||30||
pli-tv-kd1:6.31.1: iti ha tena khaṇena tena layena tena muhuttena yāva Brahmalokā saddo abbhuggacchi,
pli-tv-kd1:6.31.2: ayañ ca kho dasasahassilokadhātu saṃkampi sampakampi sampavedhi,
pli-tv-kd1:6.31.3: appamāṇo ca uḷāro obhāso loke pāturahosi atikkamma devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:6.31.4: atha kho bhagavā imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd1:6.31.5: aññāsi vata bho Koṇḍañño aññāsi vata bho Koṇḍañño 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.31.6: iti h' idaṃ āyasmato Koṇḍaññassa Aññātakoṇḍañño tv eva nāmaṃ ahosi. ||31||
pli-tv-kd1:6.32.1: atha kho āyasmā Aññātakoṇḍañño diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthu sāsane bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:6.32.2: labheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.32.4: svākkhāto dhammo, cara brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.33.1: atha kho bhagavā tadavasese bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya ovadi anusāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.33.2: atha kho āyasmato ca Vappassa āyasmato ca Bhaddiyassa bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya ovadiyamānānaṃ anusāsiyamānānaṃ virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
pli-tv-kd1:6.33.3: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman ti. ||33||
pli-tv-kd1:6.34.1: te diṭṭhadhammā pattadhammā viditadhammā pariyogāḷhadhammā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṃkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthu sāsane bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:6.34.2: labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyāma upasampadan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.34.4: svākkhāto dhammo, caratha brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.35.1: atha kho bhagavā tadavasese bhikkhū nīhārabhatto iminā nihārena dhammiyā kathāya ovadi anusāsi:
pli-tv-kd1:6.35.2: yaṃ tayo bhikkhū piṇḍāya caritvā āharanti, tena chabbaggo yāpeti. ||35||
pli-tv-kd1:6.36.1: atha kho āyasmato ca Mahānāmassa āyasmato ca Assajissa bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya ovadiyamānānaṃ anusāsiyamānānaṃ virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
pli-tv-kd1:6.36.2: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman ti. ||36||
pli-tv-kd1:6.37.1: te diṭṭhadhammā pattadhammā viditadhammā pariyogāḷhadhammā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṃkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthu sāsane bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:6.37.2: labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyāma upasampadan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.37.4: svākkhāto dhammo, caratha brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.38.1: atha kho bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:6.38.3: rūpañ ca h' idaṃ bhikkhave attā abhavissa, na yidaṃ rūpaṃ ābādhāya saṃvatteyya, labbhetha ca rūpe
pli-tv-kd1:6.38.4: evaṃ me rūpaṃ hotu, evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā ahosīti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.38.5: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave rūpaṃ anattā, tasmā rūpaṃ ābādhāya saṃvattati, na ca labbhati rūpe
pli-tv-kd1:6.38.6: evaṃ me rūpaṃ hotu, evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā ahosīti. ||38||
pli-tv-kd1:6.39.2: vedanā ca h' idaṃ bhikkhave attā abhavissa, na yidaṃ vedanā ābādhāya saṃvatteyya, labbhetha ca vedanāya
pli-tv-kd1:6.39.3: evaṃ me vedanā hotu, evaṃ me vedanā mā ahosīti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.39.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave vedanā anattā, tasmā vedanā ābādhāya saṃvattati, na ca labbhati vedanāya
pli-tv-kd1:6.39.5: evaṃ me vedanā hotu, evaṃ me vedanā mā ahosīti. ||39||
pli-tv-kd1:6.40.7: h' idaṃ bhikkhave attā abhavissaṃsu, na yidaṃ saṃkhārā ābādhāya saṃvatteyyuṃ, labbhetha ca saṃkhāresu
pli-tv-kd1:6.40.8: evaṃ me saṃkhārā hontu, evaṃ me saṃkhārā mā ahesun ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.40.9: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave saṃkhārā anattā, tasmā saṃkhārā ābādhāya saṃvattanti, na ca labbhati saṃkhāresu
pli-tv-kd1:6.40.10: evaṃ me saṃkhārā hontu, evaṃ me saṃkhārā mā ahesun ti. ||40||
pli-tv-kd1:6.41.2: viññāṇañ ca h' idaṃ bhikkhave attā abhavissa, na yidaṃ viññāṇaṃ ābādhāya saṃvatteyya, labbhetha ca viññāṇe
pli-tv-kd1:6.41.3: evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ hotu, evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ mā ahosīti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.41.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ anattā, tasmā viññāṇaṃ ābādhāya saṃvattati, na ca labbhati viññāṇe
pli-tv-kd1:6.41.5: evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ hotu, evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ mā ahosīti. ||41||
pli-tv-kd1:6.42.1: taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.42.3: yaṃ panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.42.5: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
pli-tv-kd1:6.42.6: etaṃ mama, eso 'ham asmi, eso me attā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.43.24: yaṃ panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.43.26: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammam, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
pli-tv-kd1:6.43.27: etaṃ mama, eso 'ham asmi, eso me attā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.44.1: tasmāt iha bhikkhave yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ va bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre vā santike vā, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:6.44.2: n' etaṃ mama, n' eso 'ham asmi, na me so attā 'ti
pli-tv-kd1:6.45.10: yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre vā santike vā sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:6.45.11: n' etaṃ mama, n' eso 'ham asmi, na m' eso attā 'ti
pli-tv-kd1:6.46.1: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmim pi nibbindati, vedanāya pi nibbindati, saññāya pi nibbindati, saṃkhāresu pi nibbindati, viññāṇasmim pi nibbindati,
pli-tv-kd1:6.46.4: vimuttasmiṃ vimutt' amhīti ñāṇaṃ hoti, khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā 'ti pajānātīti. ||46||
pli-tv-kd1:6.47.2: attamanā pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandanti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.47.3: imasmiñ ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne pañcavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:6.47.4: tena kho pana samayena cha loke arahanto honti. ||47||6||
pli-tv-kd1:7.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Bārāṇasiyaṃ Yaso nāma kulaputto seṭṭhiputto sukhumālo hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:7.1.3: eko hemantiko, eko gimhiko, eko vassiko.
pli-tv-kd1:7.1.4: so vassike pāsāde cattāro māse nippurisehi turiyehi paricāriyamāno na heṭṭhā pāsādā orohati.
pli-tv-kd1:7.2.1: atha kho Yasassa kulaputtassa pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitassa samaṅgibhūtassa paricāriyamānassa paṭigacc 'eva niddā okkami, parijanassāpi pacchā niddā okkami, sabbarattiyo ca telappadīpo jhāyati. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:7.2.2: atha kho Yaso kulaputto paṭigacc 'eva paṭibujjhitvā addasa sakaṃ parijanaṃ supantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:7.2.3: aññissā kacche vīṇaṃ, aññissā kaṇṭhe mutiṅgaṃ, aññissā kacche ālambaraṃ, aññaṃ vikesikaṃ, aññaṃ vikkheḷikaṃ, vippalapantiyo, hatthappattaṃ susānaṃ maññe.
pli-tv-kd1:7.2.4: disvān' assa ādīnavo pāturahosi, nibbidāya cittaṃ saṇṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:7.2.5: atha kho Yaso kulaputto udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd1:7.2.6: upaddutaṃ vata bho, upassaṭṭhaṃ vata bho 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:7.3.1: atha kho Yaso kulaputto suvaṇṇapādukāyo ārohitvā yena nivesanadvāraṃ ten' upasaṃkami,
pli-tv-kd1:7.3.3: mā Yasassa kulaputtassa koci antarāyaṃ akāsi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.3.4: atha kho Yaso kulaputto yena nagaradvāraṃ ten' upasaṃkami,
pli-tv-kd1:7.3.6: mā Yasassa kulaputtassa koci antarāyaṃ akāsi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.3.7: atha kho Yaso kulaputto yena Isipatanaṃ migadāyo ten' upasaṃkami. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:7.4.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya ajjhokāse caṅkamati.
pli-tv-kd1:7.4.2: addasa kho bhagavā Yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ, disvāna caṅkamā orohitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:7.4.3: atha kho Yaso kulaputto bhagavato avidūre udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd1:7.4.4: upaddutaṃ vata bho, upassaṭṭhaṃ vata bho 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.4.5: atha kho bhagavā Yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:7.4.6: idaṃ kho Yasa anupaddutaṃ, idaṃ anupassaṭṭhaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:7.4.7: ehi Yasa nisīda, dhammaṃ te desessāmīti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd1:7.5.2: idaṃ kira anupaddutaṃ, idaṃ anupassaṭṭhan ti haṭṭho udaggo suvaṇṇapādukāhi orohitvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:7.5.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnassa kho Yasassa kulaputtassa bhagavā anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:7.5.4: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi. ||5||
pli-tv-kd1:7.6.1: yadā bhagavā āññāsi Yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi,
pli-tv-kd1:7.6.3: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammad eva rajanaṃ paṭigaṇheyya,
pli-tv-kd1:7.6.4: evam eva Yasassa kulaputtassa tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
pli-tv-kd1:7.6.5: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman ti. ||6||
pli-tv-kd1:7.7.1: atha kho Yasassa kulaputtassa mātā pāsādaṃ abhirūhitvā Yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ apassantī yena seṭṭhi gahapati ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā seṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:7.7.2: putto te gahapati Yaso na dissatīti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.7.3: atha kho seṭṭhi gahapati catuddisā assadūte uyyojetvā sāmaṃ yeva yena Isipatanaṃ migadāyo ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-kd1:7.7.4: addasa kho seṭṭhi gahapati suvaṇṇapādukānaṃ nikkhepaṃ, disvāna taṃ yeva anugamāsi. ||7||ḥ
pli-tv-kd1:7.8.1: addasa kho bhagavā seṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ, disvāna bhagavato etad ahosi: yaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:7.8.2: nūnāhaṃ tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkhāreyyaṃ, yathā seṭṭhi gahapati idha nisinno idha nisinnaṃ Yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ na passeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.8.3: atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkhāresi. ||8||
pli-tv-kd1:7.9.1: atha kho seṭṭhi gahapati yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:7.9.2: api bhante bhagavā Yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ passeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.9.3: tena hi gahapati nisīda. app eva nāma idha nisinno idha nisinnaṃ Yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ passeyyāsīti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.9.5: idh' eva kirāhaṃ nisinno idha nisinnaṃ Yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ passissāmīti haṭṭho udaggo bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ||9||
pli-tv-kd1:7.10.1: ekamantaṃ nisinnassa kho seṭṭhissa gahapatissa bhagavā anupubbikathaṃ kathesi -- la
pli-tv-kd1:7.10.10: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya
pli-tv-kd1:7.10.13: es' āhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca,
pli-tv-kd1:7.10.14: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.10.15: so 'va loke paṭhamaṃ upāsako ahosi tevāciko. ||10||
pli-tv-kd1:7.11.1: atha kho Yasassa kulaputtassa pituno dhamme desiyamāne yathādiṭṭhaṃ yathāviditaṃ bhūmiṃ paccavekkhantassa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucci.
pli-tv-kd1:7.11.3: Yasassa kulaputtassa pituno dhamme desiyamāne yathādiṭṭhaṃ yathāviditaṃ bhūmiṃ paccavekkhantassa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:7.11.4: abhabbo kho Yaso kulaputto hīnāyāvattitvā kāme paribhuñjituṃ seyyathāpi pubbe agārikabhūto.
pli-tv-kd1:7.11.5: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ taṃ iddhābhisaṃkhāraṃ paṭippassambheyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.11.6: atha kho bhagavā taṃ iddhābhisaṃkhāraṃ paṭippassambhesi. ||11||
pli-tv-kd1:7.12.1: addasa kho seṭṭhi gahapati Yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ nisinnaṃ, disvāna Yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:7.12.2: mātā tetāta Yasa paridevasokasampannā, dehi mātu jīvitan ti. ||12||
pli-tv-kd1:7.13.1: atha kho Yaso kulaputto bhagavantaṃ ullokesi.
pli-tv-kd1:7.13.2: atha kho bhagavā seṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:7.13.3: taṃ kiṃ maññasi gahapati, Yasassa sekhena ñāṇena sekhena dassanena dhammo diṭṭho seyyathāpi tayā. tassa yathādiṭṭhaṃ yathāviditaṃ bhūmiṃ paccavekkhantassa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:7.13.4: bhabbo nu kho Yaso gahapati hīnāyāvattitvā kāme paribhuñjituṃ seyyathāpi pubbe agārikabhūto 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.13.6: Yasassa kho gahapati kulaputtassa sekhena ñāṇena sekhena dassanena dhammo diṭṭho seyyathāpi tayā. tassa yathādiṭṭhaṃ yathāviditaṃ bhūmiṃ paccavekkhantassa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:7.13.7: abhabbo kho gahapati Yaso kulaputto hīnāyāvattitvā kāme paribhuñjituṃ seyyathāpi pubbe agārikabhūto 'ti. ||13||
pli-tv-kd1:7.14.1: lābhā bhante Yasassa kulaputtassa, suladdhaṃ bhante Yasassa kulaputtassa, yathā Yasassa kulaputtassa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:7.14.2: adhivāsetu me bhante bhagavā ajjatanāya bhattaṃ Yasena kulaputtena pacchāsamaṇenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.14.4: atha kho seṭṭhi gahapati bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi. ||14||
pli-tv-kd1:7.15.1: atha kho Yaso kulaputto acirappakkante seṭṭhimhi gahapatimhi bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:7.15.2: labheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.15.4: svākkhāto dhammo, cara brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.15.6: tena kho pana samayena satta loke arahanto honti. ||15||
pli-tv-kd1:8.1.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya āyasmatā Yasena pacchāsamaṇena yena seṭṭhissa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:8.1.2: atha kho āyasmato Yasassa mātā ca purāṇadutiyikā ca yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantam nisīdiṃsu. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:8.2.1: tāsaṃ bhagavā anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:8.2.2: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
pli-tv-kd1:8.2.3: yadā tā bhagavā aññāsi kallacittā muducittā vinīvaraṇacittā uddaggacittā pasannacittā, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi,
pli-tv-kd1:8.2.5: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammad eva rajanaṃ paṭigaṇheyya,
pli-tv-kd1:8.2.6: evam eva tāsaṃ tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
pli-tv-kd1:8.2.7: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:8.3.1: tā diṭṭhadhammā pattadhammā viditadhammā pariyogāḷhadhammā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṃkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthu sāsane bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:8.3.3: etā mayaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca,
pli-tv-kd1:8.3.4: upāsikāyo no bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetā saraṇaṃ gatā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:8.3.5: tā 'va loke paṭhamaṃ upāsikā ahesuṃ tevācikā. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:8.4.1: atha kho āyasmato Yasassa mātā ca pitā ca purāṇadutiyikā ca bhagavantañ ca āyasmantañ ca Yasaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:8.4.2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato Yasassa mātarañ ca pitarañ ca purāṇadutiyikañ ca dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi. ||4||8||
pli-tv-kd1:9.1.1: assosuṃ kho āyasmato Yasassa cattāro gihisahāyakā Bārāṇasiyaṃ seṭṭhānuseṭṭhīnaṃ kulānaṃ puttā
pli-tv-kd1:9.1.3: Yaso kira kulaputto kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:9.1.5: na hi nūna so orako dhammavinayo, na sā orakā pabbajjā, yattha Yaso kulaputto kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:9.2.1: te cattāro janā yenāyasmā Yaso ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Yasaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:9.2.2: atha kho āyasmā Yaso te cattāro gihisahāyake ādāya yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:9.2.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Yaso bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:9.2.4: ime me bhante cattāro gihisahāyakā Bārāṇasiyaṃ seṭṭhānuseṭṭhīnaṃ kulānaṃ puttā
pli-tv-kd1:9.3.1: tesaṃ bhagavā anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyath' īdaṃ:

pli-tv-kd1:9.3.3: yadā te bhagavā aññāsi kallacitte muducitte vinīvaraṇacitte udaggacitte pasannacitte, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi, dukkhaṃ samudayaṃ nirodhaṃ maggaṃ.

pli-tv-kd1:11.1.2: mutt' āhaṃ bhikkhave sabbapāsehi ye dibbā ye ca mānusā.
pli-tv-kd1:11.1.3: tumhe pi bhikkhave muttā sabbapāsehi ye dibbā ye ca mānusā.
pli-tv-kd1:11.1.4: caratha bhikkhave cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:11.1.6: desetha bhikkhave dhammaṃ ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetha.
pli-tv-kd1:11.1.7: santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti, bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro.
pli-tv-kd1:11.1.8: aham pi bhikkhave yena Uruvelā yena Senāninigamo ten' upasaṃkamissāmi dhammadesanāyā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:11.2.1: atha kho Māro pāpimā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
pli-tv-kd1:11.2.19: jānāti maṃ bhagavā, jānāti maṃ sugato 'ti dukkhī dummano tatth' ev' antaradhāyīti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:12.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū nānādisā nānājanapadā pabbajjāpekkhe ca upasampadāpekkhe ca ānenti
pli-tv-kd1:12.1.3: tattha bhikkhū c' eva kilamanti pabbajjāpekkhā ca upasampadāpekkhā ca.
pli-tv-kd1:12.1.4: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd1:12.1.5: etarahi kho bhikkhū nānādisā nānājanapadā pabbajjāpekkhe ca upasampadāpekkhe ca ānenti
pli-tv-kd1:12.1.7: tattha bhikkhū c' eva kilamanti pabbajjāpekkhā ca upasampadāpekkhā ca.
pli-tv-kd1:12.1.9: tumheva dāni bhikkhave tāsu-tāsu disāsu tesu-tesu janapadesu pabbājetha upasampādethā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:12.2.1: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito etasmiṃ nidāne --pa-- dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:12.2.2: idha mayhaṃ bhikkhave rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd1:12.2.3: etarahi kho bhikkhū nānādisā nānājanapadā pabbajjāpekkhe ca upasampadāpekkhe ca ānenti
pli-tv-kd1:12.2.4: bhagavā ne pabbājessati upasampādessatīti, tattha bhikkhū c' eva kilamanti pabbajjāpekkhā ca upasampadāpekkhā ca.
pli-tv-kd1:12.3.1: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anujāneyyaṃ tumheva dāni bhikkhave tāsu-tāsu disāsu tesu-tesu janapadesu pabbājetha upasampādethā 'ti. ||2|| anujānāmi bhikkhave tumheva dāni tāsu-tāsu disāsu tesu-tesu janapadesu pabbājetha upasampādetha.
pli-tv-kd1:12.3.2: evañ ca pana bhikkhave pabbājetabbo upasampādetabbo:
pli-tv-kd1:12.3.3: paṭhamaṃ kesamassuṃ ohārāpetvā, kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādāpetvā, ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ kārāpetvā, bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vandāpetvā, ukkuṭikaṃ nisīdāpetvā, añjaliṃ paggaṇhāpetvā evaṃ vadehīti vattabbo: ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:12.4.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave imehi tīhi saraṇagamanehi pabbajjaṃ upasampadan ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd1:13.1.1: atha kho bhagavā vassaṃ vuttho bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:13.1.2: mayhaṃ kho bhikkhave yonisomanasikārā yonisosammappadhānā anuttarā vimutti anuppattā anuttarā vimutti sacchikatā.
pli-tv-kd1:13.1.3: tumhe pi bhikkhave yonisomanasikārā yonisosammappadhānā anuttaraṃ vimuttiṃ anupāpuṇātha anuttaraṃ vimuttiṃ sacchikarothā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:13.2.1: atha kho Māro pāpimā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
pli-tv-kd1:13.2.11: jānāti maṃ bhagavā, jānāti maṃ sugato 'ti dukkhī dummano tatth' ev' antaradhāyi. ||2||13||
pli-tv-kd1:14.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Bārāṇasiyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Uruvelā tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:14.1.2: atha kho bhagavā maggā okkamma yena aññataro vanasaṇḍo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:14.1.3: tena kho pana samayena tiṃsamattā Bhaddavaggiyā sahāyakā sapajāpatikā tasmiṃ yeva vanasaṇḍe paricārenti.
pli-tv-kd1:14.1.6: atha kho sā vesī tesu pamattesu paricārentesu bhaṇḍaṃ ādāya palāyittha. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:14.2.1: atha kho te sahāyakā sahāyakassa veyyāvaccaṃ karontā taṃ itthiṃ gavesantā taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ āhiṇḍantā addasaṃsu bhagavantaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinnaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:14.2.2: disvāna yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:14.2.3: api bhante bhagavā ekaṃ itthiṃ passeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:14.2.5: idha mayaṃ bhante tiṃsamattā Bhaddavaggiyā sahāyakā sapajāpatikā imasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe paricārayimhā,
pli-tv-kd1:14.2.8: atha kho sā bhante vesī amhesu pamattesu paricārentesu bhaṇḍaṃ ādāya palāyittha.
pli-tv-kd1:14.2.9: tena mayaṃ bhante sahāyakā sahāyakassa veyyāvaccaṃ karontā taṃ itthiṃ gavesantā imaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ āhiṇḍāmā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:14.3.1: taṃ kiṃ maññatha vo kumārā, katamaṃ nu kho tumhākaṃ varaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:14.3.2: yaṃ vā tumhe itthiṃ gaveseyyātha yaṃ vā attānaṃ gaveseyyāthā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:14.3.3: etad eva bhante amhākaṃ varaṃ yaṃ mayaṃ attānaṃ gaveseyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:14.3.4: tena hi vo kumārā nisīdatha, dhammaṃ vo desessāmīti.
pli-tv-kd1:14.3.5: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho te Bhaddavaggiyā sahāyakā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:14.4.1: tesaṃ bhagavā anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:14.4.2: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
pli-tv-kd1:14.4.3: yadā te bhagavā aññāsi kallacitte muducitte vinīvaraṇacitte udaggacitte pasannacitte, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā, taṃ pakāsesi, dukkhaṃ samudayaṃ nirodhaṃ maggaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:14.4.4: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammad eva rajanaṃ paṭigaṇheyya,
pli-tv-kd1:14.4.5: evam eva tesaṃ tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
pli-tv-kd1:14.4.6: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhammaṃ ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd1:14.5.1: te diṭṭhadhammā pattadhammā viditadhammā pariyogāḷhadhammā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṃkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthu sāsane bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:14.5.2: labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyāma upasampadan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:14.5.4: svākkhāto dhammo, caratha brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.1.1: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Uruvelā tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd1:15.1.2: tena kho pana samayena Uruvelāyaṃ tayo jaṭilā paṭivasanti
pli-tv-kd1:15.1.4: tesu Uruvelakassapo jaṭilo pañcannaṃ jaṭilasatānaṃ nāyako hoti vināyako aggo pamukho pāmokkho,
pli-tv-kd1:15.1.5: Nadīkassapo jaṭilo tiṇṇaṃ jaṭilasatānaṃ nāyako hoti vināyako aggo pamukho pāmokkho,
pli-tv-kd1:15.1.6: Gayākassapo jaṭilo dvinnaṃ jaṭilasatānaṃ nāyako hoti vināyako aggo pamukho pāmokkho. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.1: atha kho bhagavā yena Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa assamo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.2: sace te Kassapa agaru, vaseyyāma ekarattaṃ agyāgāre 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.3: na kho me mahāsamaṇa garu, caṇḍ' ettha nāgarājā iddhimā āsiviso ghoraviso, so taṃ mā viheṭhesīti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.4: dutiyam pi kho bhagavā Uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.5: sace te Kassapa agaru, vaseyyāma ekarattaṃ agyāgāre 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.6: na kho me mahāsamaṇa garu, caṇḍ' ettha nāgarājā iddhimā āsiviso ghoraviso, so taṃ mā viheṭhesīti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.7: tatiyam pi kho bhagavā Uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.8: sace te Kassapa agaru, vaseyyāma ekarattaṃ agyāgāre 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.9: na kho me mahāsamaṇa garu, caṇḍ' ettha nāgarājā iddhimā āsiviso ghoraviso, so taṃ mā viheṭhesīti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.10: app eva maṃ na viheṭheyya, iṅgha tvaṃ Kassapa anujānāhi agyāgāran ti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.3.1: atha kho bhagavā agyāgāraṃ pavisitvā tiṇasantharakaṃ paññāpetvā nisīdi pallaṅkaṃ ābhuñjitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā.
pli-tv-kd1:15.3.2: atha kho so nāgo bhagavantaṃ paviṭṭhaṃ addasa, disvāna dukkhī dummano padhūpāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:15.3.3: atha kho bhagavato etad ahosi: yaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:15.3.4: nūnāhaṃ imassa nāgassa anupahacca chaviñ ca cammañ ca maṃsañ ca nhāruñ ca aṭṭhiñ ca aṭṭhimiñjañ ca tejasā tejaṃ pariyādiyeyyan ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:15.4.1: atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharitvā padhūpāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:15.4.2: atha kho so nāgo makkhaṃ asahamāno pajjali.
pli-tv-kd1:15.4.4: ubhinnaṃ sajotibhūtānaṃ agyāgāraṃ ādittaṃ viya hoti sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:15.4.5: atha kho te jaṭilā agyāgāraṃ parivāretvā evaṃ āhaṃsu:
pli-tv-kd1:15.4.6: abhirūpo vata bho mahāsamaṇo, nāgena viheṭhiyissatīti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd1:15.5.1: atha kho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena tassa nāgassa anupahacca chaviñ ca cammañ ca maṃsañ ca nhāruñ ca aṭṭhiñ ca aṭṭhimiñjañ ca tejasā tejaṃ pariyādiyitvā patte pakkhipitvā Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa dassesi:
pli-tv-kd1:15.5.2: ayaṃ te Kassapa nāgo, pariyādinno assa tejasā tejo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.5.3: atha kho Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:15.5.4: mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma caṇḍassa nāgarājassa iddhimato āsivisassa ghoravisassa tejasā tejaṃ pariyādiyissati, na tv eva ca kho arahā yathā ahan ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd1:15.6.11: iṅgha tvaṃ Kassapa anujānāhi agyāgāran ti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.7.13: atha kho Uruvelakassapo jaṭilo bhagavato iminā iddhipāṭihāriyena abhippasanno bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:15.7.14: idh' eva mahāsamaṇa vihara, ahan te dhuvabhattenā 'ti. ||7||
pli-tv-kd1:16.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa assamassa avidūre aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe vihāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:16.1.2: atha kho cattāro Mahārājāno abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā catuddisā aṭṭhaṃsu seyyathāpi mahantā aggikkhandhā. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:16.2.1: atha kho Uruvelakassapo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:16.2.3: ke nu kho te mahāsamaṇa abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ obhāsetvā yena tvaṃ ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ abhivādetvā catuddisā aṭṭhaṃsu seyyathāpi mahantā aggikkhandhā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:16.2.4: ete kho Kassapa cattāro Mahārājāno yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu dhammasavanāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:16.2.5: atha kho Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:16.2.6: mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhavo, yatra hi nāma cattāro pi Mahārājāno upasaṃkamissanti dhammasavanāya, na tv eva ca kho arahā yathā ahan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:16.2.7: atha kho bhagavā Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ bhuñjitvā tasmiṃ yeva vanasaṇḍe vihāsi. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:17.1.1: atha kho Sakko devānam indo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi seyyathāpi mahā aggikkhandho, pūrimāhi vaṇṇanibhāhi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:17.2.1: atha kho Uruvelakassapo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā ten' upasāmi, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:17.2.3: ko nu kho so mahāsamaṇa abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ obhāsetvā yena tvaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi seyyathāpi mahā aggikkhandho purimāhi vaṇṇanibhāhi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:17.2.4: eso kho Kassapa Sakko devānam indo yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami dhammasavanāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:17.2.5: atha kho Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:17.2.6: mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma Sakko pi devānam indo upasaṃkamissati dhammasavanāya, na tv eva ca kho arahā yathā ahan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:17.2.7: atha kho bhagavā Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ bhuñjitvā tasmiṃ yeva vanasaṇḍe vihāsi. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:18.1.1: atha kho Brahmā Sahaṃpati abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi seyyathāpi mahā aggikkhandho purimāhi vaṇṇanibhāhi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:18.2.1: atha kho Uruvelakassapo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:18.2.3: ko nu kho so mahāsamaṇa abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ obhāsetvā yena tvaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi seyyathāpi mahā aggikkhandho purimāhi vaṇṇanibhāhi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:18.2.4: eso kho Kassapa Brahmā Sahaṃpati yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami dhammasavanāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:18.2.5: atha kho Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:18.2.6: mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma Brahmāpi Sahaṃpati upasaṃkamissati dhammasavanāya, na tv eva ca kho arahā yathā ahan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:18.2.7: atha kho bhagavā Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ bhuñjitvā tasmiṃ yeva vanasaṇḍe vihāsi. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:19.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa mahāyañño paccupaṭṭhito hoti kevalakappā ca Aṅgamagadhā pahūtaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ ādāya abhikkamitukāmā honti.
pli-tv-kd1:19.1.2: atha kho Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:19.1.3: etarahi kho me mahāyañño paccupaṭṭhito kevalakappā ca Aṅgamagadhā pahūtaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ ādāya abhikkamissanti.
pli-tv-kd1:19.1.4: sace mahāsamaṇo mahājanakāye iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karissati, mahāsamaṇassa lābhasakkāro abhivaḍḍhissati, mama lābhasakkāro parihāyissati.
pli-tv-kd1:19.2.1: atha kho bhagavā Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya Uttarakuruṃ gantvā tato piṇḍapātaṃ āharitvā Anotattadahe paribhuñjitvā tatth' eva divāvihāraṃ akāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:19.2.2: atha kho Uruvelakassapo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:19.2.4: kiṃ nu kho mahāsamaṇa hiyyo nāgamāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:19.2.7: khādaniyassa ca bhojaniyassa ca te paṭiviso ṭhapito 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:19.3.2: etarahi kho me mahāyañño paccupaṭṭhito kevalakappā ca Aṅgamagadhā pahūtaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ ādāya abhikkamissanti. sace mahāsamaṇo mahājanakāye iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karissati, mahāsamaṇassa lābhasakkāro abhivaḍḍhissati, mama lābhasakkāro parihāyissati. aho nūna mahāsamaṇo svātanāya nāgaccheyyā 'ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:19.4.1: so kho ahaṃ Kassapa tava cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya Uttarakuruṃ gantvā tato piṇḍapātaṃ āharitvā Anotattadahe paribhuñjitvā tatth' eva divāvihāraṃ akāsin ti.
pli-tv-kd1:19.4.2: atha kho Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:19.4.3: mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma cetasāpi cittaṃ pajānissati, na tv eva ca kho arahā yathā ahan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:19.4.4: atha kho bhagavā Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ paribhuñjitvā tasmiṃ yeva vanasaṇḍe vihāsi. ||4||
pli-tv-kd1:20.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavato paṃsukūlaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.1.3: kattha nu kho ahaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ dhoveyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.1.4: atha kho Sakko devānam indo bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya pāṇinā pokkharaṇiṃ khanitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.1.7: kimhi nu kho ahaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ parimaddeyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.1.8: atha kho Sakko devānam indo bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya mahatiṃ silaṃ upanikkhipi
pli-tv-kd1:20.2.2: kimhi nu kho ahaṃ ālambitvā uttareyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.2.3: atha kho kakudhe adhivatthā devatā bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya sākhaṃ onamesi
pli-tv-kd1:20.2.6: kimhi nu kho ahaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ vissajjeyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.2.7: atha kho Sakko devānam indo bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya mahatiṃ silaṃ upanikkhipi
pli-tv-kd1:20.3.1: atha kho Uruvelakassapo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.3.3: kiṃ nu kho mahāsamaṇa nāyaṃ pubbe idha pokkharaṇī, sāyaṃ idha pokkharaṇī,
pli-tv-kd1:20.3.6: na yimassa kakudhassa pubbe sākhā onatā, sāyaṃ sākhā onatā 'ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:20.4.1: idha me Kassapa paṃsukūlaṃ uppannaṃ ahosi,
pli-tv-kd1:20.4.3: kattha nu kho ahaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ dhoveyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.4.4: atha kho Kassapa Sakko devānam indo mama cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya pāṇinā pokkharaṇiṃ khanitvā maṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.4.8: kimhi nu kho ahaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ parimaddeyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.4.9: atha kho Kassapa Sakko devānam indo mama cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya mahatiṃ silaṃ upanikkhipi
pli-tv-kd1:20.5.2: kimhi nu kho ahaṃ ālambitvā uttareyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.5.3: atha kho Kassapa kakudhe adhivatthā devatā mama cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya sākhaṃ onamesi
pli-tv-kd1:20.5.7: kimhi nu kho ahaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ vissajjeyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.5.8: atha kho Sakko devānam indo mama cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya mahatiṃ silaṃ upanikkhipi
pli-tv-kd1:20.6.1: atha kho Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.6.2: mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma Sakko devānam indo veyyāvaccaṃ karissati, na tv eva ca kho arahā yathā ahan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.6.3: atha kho bhagavā Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ bhuñjitvā tasmiṃ yeva vanasaṇḍe vihāsi. ||6||
pli-tv-kd1:20.7.1: atha kho Uruvelakassapo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocesi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.7.3: gaccha tvaṃ Kassapa, āyām' ahan ti Uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ uyyojetvā yāya jambuyāyaṃ Jambudīpo paññāyati, tato phalaṃ gahetvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgāre nisīdi. ||7||
pli-tv-kd1:20.8.1: addasa kho Uruvelakassapo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ agyāgāre nisinnaṃ, disvāna bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.8.3: ahaṃ tayā paṭhamataraṃ pakkanto, so tvaṃ paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgāre nisinno 'ti. ||8||
pli-tv-kd1:20.9.1: idhāhaṃ Kassapa taṃ uyyojetvā yāya jambuyāyaṃ Jambudīpo paññāyati, tato phalaṃ gahetvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgāre nisinno.
pli-tv-kd1:20.9.2: idaṃ kho Kassapa jambuphalaṃ vaṇṇasampannaṃ gandhasampannaṃ rasasampannaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:20.9.4: alaṃ mahāsamaṇa, tvaṃ yev' etaṃ arahasi, tvaṃ yev' etaṃ paribhuñjāhīti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.9.5: atha kho Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.9.6: mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma maṃ paṭhamataraṃ uyyojetvā yāya jambuyāyaṃ Jambūdipo paññāyati, tato phalaṃ gahetvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgāre nisīdissati, na tv eva ca kho arahā yathā ahan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.9.7: atha kho bhagavā Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ bhuñjitvā tasmiṃ yeva vanasaṇḍe vihāsi. ||9||
pli-tv-kd1:20.10.1: atha kho Uruvelakassapo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocesi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.10.3: gaccha tvaṃ Kassapa, āyām' ahan ti Uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ uyyojetvā yāya jambuyāyaṃ Jambudīpo paññāyati, tassā avidūre ambo --gha--
pli-tv-kd1:20.10.6: Tāvatiṃsaṃ gantvā pāricchattakapupphaṃ gahetvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgāre nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:20.10.7: addasa kho Uruvelakassapo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ agyāgāre nisinnaṃ, disvāna bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.10.9: ahaṃ tayā paṭhamataraṃ pakkanto, so tvaṃ paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgāre nisinno 'ti. ||10||
pli-tv-kd1:20.11.1: idhāhaṃ Kassapa taṃ uyyojetvā Tāvatiṃsaṃ gantvā pāricchattakapupphaṃ gahetvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgāre nisinno.
pli-tv-kd1:20.11.2: idaṃ kho Kassapa pāricchattakapupphaṃ vaṇṇasampannaṃ gandhasampannaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:20.11.4: alaṃ mahāsamaṇa, tvaṃ yev' etaṃ arahasi, tvaṃ yev' etaṃ gaṇhā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.11.5: atha kho Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.11.6: mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma maṃ paṭhamataraṃ uyyojetvā Tāvatiṃsaṃ gantvā pāricchattakapupphaṃ gahetvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgāre nisīdissati, na tv eva ca kho arahā yathā ahan ti. ||11||
pli-tv-kd1:20.12.1: tena kho pana samayena te jaṭilā aggī paricaritukāmā na sakkonti kaṭṭhāni phāletuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:20.12.2: atha kho tesaṃ jaṭilānaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.12.3: nissaṃsayaṃ kho mahāsamaṇassa iddhānubhāvo, yathā mayaṃ na sakkoma kaṭṭhāni phāletun ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.12.4: atha kho bhagavā Uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.12.8: atha kho Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.12.9: mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma kaṭṭhāni pi phāliyissanti, na tv eva ca kho arahā yathā ahan ti. ||12||
pli-tv-kd1:20.13.1: tena kho pana samayena te jaṭilā aggī paricaritukāmā na sakkonti aggī ujjaletuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:20.13.2: atha kho tesaṃ jaṭilānaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.13.3: nissaṃsayaṃ kho mahāsamaṇassa iddhānubhāvo, yathā mayaṃ na sakkoma aggī ujjaletun ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.13.4: atha kho bhagavā Uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.13.8: atha kho Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.13.9: mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma aggī pi ujjaliyissanti, na tv eva ca kho arahā yathā ahan ti. ||13||
pli-tv-kd1:20.14.1: tena kho pana samayena te jaṭilā aggī paricaritvā na sakkonti aggī vijjhāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:20.14.2: atha kho tesaṃ jaṭilānaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.14.3: nissaṃsayaṃ kho mahāsamaṇassa iddhānubhāvo, yathā mayaṃ na sakkoma aggī vijjhāpetun ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.14.4: atha kho bhagavā Uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.14.8: atha kho Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.14.9: mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma aggī pi vijjhāyissanti, na tv eva ca kho arahā yathā ahan ti. ||14||
pli-tv-kd1:20.15.1: tena kho pana samayena te jaṭilā sītāsu hemantikāsu rattisu antaraṭṭhakāsu himapātasamaye najjā Nerañjarāyaṃ nimujjanti pi, ummujjanti pi, ummujjanimujjam pi karonti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.15.2: atha kho bhagavā pañcamattāni mandāmukhisatāni abhinimmini, yattha te jaṭilā uttaritvā visibbesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:20.15.3: atha kho tesaṃ jaṭilānaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.15.4: nissaṃsayaṃ kho mahāsamaṇassa iddhānubhāvo, yathā h' imā mandāmukhiyo nimmitā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.15.5: atha kho Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.15.6: mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma mahāmandāmukhiyo abhinimminissati, na tv eva ca kho arahā yathā ahan ti. ||15||
pli-tv-kd1:20.16.1: tena kho pana samayena mahāakālamegho vassi, mahāudakavāhako sañjāyi.
pli-tv-kd1:20.16.2: yasmiṃ padese bhagavā viharati, so padeso udakena anuotthaṭo hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.16.3: atha kho bhagavato etad ahosi: yaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:20.16.4: nūnāhaṃ samantā udakaṃ ussāretvā majjhe reṇuhatāya bhūmiyā caṅkameyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.16.5: atha kho bhagavā samantā udakaṃ ussāretvā majjhe reṇuhatāya bhūmiyā caṅkami.
pli-tv-kd1:20.16.7: mā h' eva kho mahāsamaṇo udakena vuḷho ahosīti nāvāya sambahulehi jaṭilehi saddhiṃ yasmiṃ padese bhagavā viharati taṃ padesaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:20.16.8: addasa kho Uruvelakassapo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ samantā udakaṃ ussāretvā majjhe reṇuhatāya bhūmiyā caṅkamantaṃ, disvāna bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.16.9: idha nu tvaṃ mahāsamaṇā 'ti. ayam ah'
pli-tv-kd1:20.16.12: atha kho Uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.16.13: mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma udakam pi na pavahissati, na tv eva ca kho arahā yathā ahan ti. ||16||
pli-tv-kd1:20.17.2: ciram pi kho imassa moghapurisassa evaṃ bhavissati:
pli-tv-kd1:20.17.3: mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, na tv eva ca kho arahā yathā ahan ti. yaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:20.17.5: atha kho bhagavā Uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.17.6: n' eva kho tvaṃ Kassapa arahā, na pi arahattamaggaṃ samāpanno,
pli-tv-kd1:20.17.7: sā pi te paṭipadā n' atthi, yāya tvaṃ arahā vā assa arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpanno 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.17.8: atha kho Uruvelakassapo jaṭilo bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.17.9: labheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadan ti. ||17||
pli-tv-kd1:20.18.1: tvaṃ kho 'si Kassapa pañcannaṃ jaṭilasatānaṃ nāyako vināyako aggo pamukho pāmokkho,
pli-tv-kd1:20.18.2: te pi tāva apalokehi, yathā te maññissanti tathā karissantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.18.3: atha kho Uruvelakassapo jaṭilo yena te jaṭilā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā te jaṭile etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.18.4: icchām' ahaṃ bho mahāsamaṇe brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ, yathā bhavanto maññanti tathā karontū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.18.5: cirapaṭikā mayaṃ bho mahāsamaṇe abhippasannā, sace bhavaṃ mahāsamaṇe brahmacariyaṃ carissati, sabbeva mayaṃ mahāsamaṇe brahmacariyaṃ carissāmā 'ti. ||18||
pli-tv-kd1:20.19.1: atha kho te jaṭilā kesamissaṃ jaṭāmissaṃ khārikājamissaṃ aggihuttamissaṃ udake pavāhetvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:20.19.2: labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyāma upasampadan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.19.4: svākkhāto dhammo, caratha brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.20.1: addasa kho Nadīkassapo jaṭilo kesamissaṃ jaṭāmissaṃ khārikājamissaṃ aggihuttamissaṃ udake vuyhamāne, disvān' assa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.20.2: mā h' eva me bhātuno upasaggo ahosīti,
pli-tv-kd1:20.20.5: sāmañ ca tīhi jaṭilasatehi saddhiṃ yenāyasmā Uruvelakassapo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Uruvelakassapaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.21.1: atha kho te jaṭilā kesamissaṃ jaṭāmissaṃ khārikājamissaṃ aggihuttamissaṃ udake pavāhetvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:20.21.2: labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyāma upasampadan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.21.4: svākkhāto dhammo, caratha brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.22.1: addasa kho Gayākassapo jaṭilo kesamissaṃ jaṭāmissaṃ khārikājamissaṃ aggihuttamissaṃ udake vuyhamāne, disvān' assa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.22.2: mā h' eva me bhātūnaṃ upasaggo ahosīti,
pli-tv-kd1:20.22.5: sāmañ ca dvīhi jaṭilasatehi saddhiṃ yenāyasmā Uruvelakassapo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Uruvelakassapaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.23.1: atha kho te jaṭilā kesamissaṃ jaṭāmissaṃ khārikājamissaṃ aggihuttamissaṃ udake pavāhetvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:20.23.2: labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyāma upasampadan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.23.4: svākkhāto dhammo, caratha brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.24.1: bhagavato adhiṭṭhānena pañca kaṭṭhasatāni na phāliyiṃsu, phāliyiṃsu,
pli-tv-kd1:21.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Uruvelāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Gayāsīsaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ bhikkhusahassena sabbeh' eva purāṇajaṭilehi.
pli-tv-kd1:21.1.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Gayāyaṃ viharati Gayāsīse saddhiṃ bhikkhusahassena. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:21.2.4: cakkhuṃ bhikkhave ādittaṃ, rūpā ādittā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ, cakkhusamphasso āditto, yad idaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, tam pi ādittaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:21.2.6: rāgagginā dosagginā mohagginā ādittaṃ, jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi ādittan ti vadāmi. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:21.3.13: mano āditto, dhammā ādittā, manoviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ, manosamphasso āditto, yad idaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, tam pi ādittaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:21.3.15: rāgagginā dosagginā mohagginā ādittaṃ, jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi ādittan ti vadāmi. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:21.4.1: evam passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmiṃ pi nibbindati, rūpesu pi nibbindati, cakkhuviññāṇe pi nibbindati, cakkhusamphasse pi nibbindati, yad idaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, tasmiṃ pi nibbindati.
pli-tv-kd1:21.4.2: sotasmiṃ pi nibbindati, saddesu pi nibbindati,
pli-tv-kd1:21.4.3: ghānasmiṃ pi nibbindati, gandhesu pi nibbindati,
pli-tv-kd1:21.4.4: jivhāya pi nibbindati, rasesu pi nibbindati,
pli-tv-kd1:21.4.5: kāyasmiṃ pi nibbindati, phoṭṭhabbesu pi nibbindati,
pli-tv-kd1:21.4.6: manasmiṃ pi nibbindati, dhammesu pi nibbindati, manoviññāṇe pi nibbindati, manosamphasse pi nibbindati, yad idaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, tasmiṃ pi nibbindati,
pli-tv-kd1:21.4.7: nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ vimutt' amhīti ñāṇaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:21.4.8: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā 'ti pajānātīti.
pli-tv-kd1:21.4.9: imasmiṃ ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne tassa bhikkhusahassassa anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsu. ||4||
pli-tv-kd1:22.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Gayāsīse yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Rājagahaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ bhikkhusahassena sabbeh' eva purāṇajaṭilehi.
pli-tv-kd1:22.1.2: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Rājagahaṃ tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd1:22.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Laṭṭhivanuyyāne Supatiṭṭhe cetiye. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:22.2.1: assosi kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro:
pli-tv-kd1:22.2.2: samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo Sakyaputto Sakyakulā pabbajito Rājagahaṃ anuppatto Rājagahe viharati Laṭṭhivanuyyāne Supatiṭṭhe cetiye.
pli-tv-kd1:22.2.3: taṃ kho pana bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
pli-tv-kd1:22.2.4: iti pi, so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā,
pli-tv-kd1:22.2.5: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti,
pli-tv-kd1:22.2.6: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
pli-tv-kd1:22.2.7: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:22.3.1: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro dvādasanahutehi Māgadhikehi brāhmaṇagahapatikehi parivuto yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:22.3.2: te pi kho dvādasanahutā Māgadhikā brāhmaṇagahapatikā appekacce bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, appekacce bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu, sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, appekacce yena bhagavā ten' añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, appekacce bhagavato santike nāmagottaṃ sāvetvā ekamantam nisīdiṃsu, appekacce tuṇhibhūtā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:22.4.1: atha kho tesaṃ dvādasanahutānaṃ Māgadhikānaṃ brāhmaṇagahapatikānaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:22.4.2: kiṃ nu kho mahāsamaṇo Uruvelakassape brahmacariyaṃ carati, udāhu Uruvelakassapo mahāsamaṇe brahmacariyaṃ caratīti.
pli-tv-kd1:22.4.3: atha kho bhagavā tesaṃ dvādasanahutānaṃ Māgadhikānaṃ brāhmaṇagahapatikānaṃ cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya āyasmantaṃ Uruvelakassapaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
pli-tv-kd1:22.4.8: rūpe ca sadde ca atho rase ca
pli-tv-kd1:22.4.11: tasmā na yiṭṭhe na hute arañjin ti. ||4|| ettha
pli-tv-kd1:22.5.5: rato mano Kassapa brūhi me tan ti. |
pli-tv-kd1:22.5.9: tasmā na yiṭṭhe na hute arañjin ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd1:22.6.1: atha kho āyasmā Uruvelakassapo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:22.6.2: satthā me bhante bhagavā, sāvako 'ham asmi,
pli-tv-kd1:22.6.3: satthā me bhante bhagavā, sāvako 'ham asmīti.
pli-tv-kd1:22.6.4: atha kho tesaṃ dvādasanahutānaṃ Māgadhikānaṃ brāhmaṇagahapatikānaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:22.7.1: atha kho bhagavā tesaṃ dvādasanahutānaṃ Māgadhikānaṃ brāhmaṇagahapatikānaṃ cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:22.7.2: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
pli-tv-kd1:22.7.3: yadā te bhagavā aññāsi kallacitte muducitte vinīvaraṇacitte udaggacitte pasannacitte, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā, taṃ pakāsesi,
pli-tv-kd1:22.8.1: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammad eva rajanaṃ paṭigaṇheyya,
pli-tv-kd1:22.8.2: evam eva ekādasanahutānaṃ Māgadhikānaṃ brāhmaṇagahapatikānaṃ Bimbisārapamukhānaṃ tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
pli-tv-kd1:22.8.3: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman ti,
pli-tv-kd1:22.9.1: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthu sāsane bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:22.9.2: pubbe me bhante kumārassa sato pañca assāsakā ahesuṃ, te me etarahi samiddhā.
pli-tv-kd1:22.9.3: pubbe me bhante kumārassa sato etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:22.9.4: aho vata maṃ rajje abhisiñceyyun ti, ayaṃ kho me bhante paṭhamo assāsako ahosi, so me etarahi samiddho.
pli-tv-kd1:22.9.5: tassa ca me vijitaṃ arahaṃ sammāsambuddho okkameyyā 'ti, ayaṃ kho me bhante dutiyo assāsako ahosi, so me etarahi samiddho. ||9||
pli-tv-kd1:22.10.1: tañ cāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ payirupāseyyan ti, ayaṃ kho me bhante tatiyo assāsako ahosi, so me etarahi samiddho.
pli-tv-kd1:22.10.2: so ca me bhagavā dhammaṃ deseyyā 'ti, ayaṃ kho me bhante catuttho assāsako ahosi, so me etarahi samiddho.
pli-tv-kd1:22.10.3: tassa cāhaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ ājāneyyan ti, ayaṃ kho me bhante pañcamo assāsako ahosi, so me etarahi samiddho.
pli-tv-kd1:22.10.4: pubbe me bhante kumārassa sato ime pañca assāsakā ahesuṃ, te me etarahi samiddhā. ||10||
pli-tv-kd1:22.11.2: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā. ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti, evam
pli-tv-kd1:22.11.4: es' āhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca,
pli-tv-kd1:22.11.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhante bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti, adhivāsetu ca me bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:22.12.1: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:22.12.2: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi:
pli-tv-kd1:22.12.4: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Rājagahaṃ pāvisi mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ bhikkhusahassena sabbeh' eva purāṇajaṭilehi. ||12||
pli-tv-kd1:22.13.1: tena kho pana samayena Sakko devānam indo māṇavakavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā buddhapamukhassa bhikkhusaṃghassa purato-purato gacchati imā gāthāyo gīyamāno:
pli-tv-kd1:22.14.1: manussā Sakkaṃ devānam indaṃ passitvā evaṃ āhaṃsu:
pli-tv-kd1:22.14.2: abhirūpo vatāyaṃ māṇavako, dassanīyo vatāyaṃ māṇavako, pāsādiko vatāyaṃ māṇavako.
pli-tv-kd1:22.14.4: evaṃ vutte Sakko devānam indo te manusse gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
pli-tv-kd1:22.15.1: atha kho bhagavā yena rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena.
pli-tv-kd1:22.15.2: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ||15||
pli-tv-kd1:22.16.1: ekamantaṃ nisinnassa kho rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:22.16.3: yaṃ assa gāmato n' eva avidūre na accāsanne gamanāgamanasampannaṃ atthikānaṃ-atthikānaṃ manussānaṃ abhikkamanīyaṃ, divā appākiṇṇaṃ rattiṃ appasaddaṃ appanigghosaṃ vijanavātaṃ manussarāhaseyyakaṃ paṭisallānasāruppan ti. ||16||
pli-tv-kd1:22.17.1: atha kho rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:22.17.2: idaṃ kho amhākaṃ Veḷuvanaṃ uyyānaṃ gāmato n' eva avidūre na accāsanne gamanāgamanasampannaṃ atthikānaṃ-atthikānaṃ manussānaṃ abhikkamanīyaṃ, divā appākiṇṇaṃ, rattiṃ appasaddaṃ appanigghosaṃ vijanavātaṃ manussarāhaseyyakaṃ paṭisallānasāruppaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:22.17.3: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ Veḷuvanaṃ uyyānaṃ buddhapamukhassa bhikkhusaṃghassa dadeyyan ti. ||17||
pli-tv-kd1:22.18.1: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro sovaṇṇamayaṃ bhiṅkāraṃ gahetvā bhagavato onojesi
pli-tv-kd1:22.18.2: etāhaṃ bhante Veḷuvanaṃ uyyānaṃ buddhapamukhassa bhikkhusaṃghassa dammīti.
pli-tv-kd1:22.18.4: atha kho bhagavā rājānaṃ Māgadhaṃ Seniyaṃ Bimbisāraṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā saṃpahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:22.18.5: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:23.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Sañjayo paribbājako Rājagahe paṭivasati mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ aḍḍhateyyehi paribbājakasatehi.
pli-tv-kd1:23.1.2: tena kho pana samayena Sāriputtamoggallānā Sañjaye paribbājake brahmacariyaṃ caranti,
pli-tv-kd1:23.1.4: yo paṭhamaṃ amataṃ adhigacchati so ārocetū 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:23.2.1: atha kho āyasmā Assaji pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi pāsādikena abhikkantena paṭikkantena ālokitena vilokitena sammiñjitena pasāritena okkhittacakkhu iriyāpathasampanno.
pli-tv-kd1:23.2.2: addasa kho Sāriputto paribbājako āyasmantaṃ Assajiṃ Rājagahe piṇḍāya carantaṃ pāsādikena abhikkantena paṭikkantena ālokitena vilokitena sammiñjitena pasāritena okkhittacakkhuṃ iriyāpathasampannaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:23.2.4: ye vata loke arahanto vā arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpannā, ayaṃ tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ aññataro,
pli-tv-kd1:23.2.5: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṃkamitvā puccheyyaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:23.2.6: kaṃ 'si tvaṃ āvuso uddissa pabbajito, ko vā te satthā, kassa vā tvaṃ dhammaṃ rocesīti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:23.3.1: atha kho Sāriputtassa paribbājakassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:23.3.2: akālo kho imaṃ bhikkhuṃ pucchituṃ, antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho piṇḍāya carati.
pli-tv-kd1:23.3.3: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ piṭṭhito-piṭṭhito anubandheyyaṃ atthikehi upaññātaṃ maggan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:23.3.4: atha kho āyasmā Assaji Rājagahe piṇḍāya caritvā piṇḍapātaṃ ādāya paṭikkami.
pli-tv-kd1:23.3.5: atha kho Sāriputto paribbājako yenāyasmā Assaji ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmatā Assajinā saddhiṃ sammodi, sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-kd1:23.3.6: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Sāriputto paribbājako āyasmantaṃ Assajiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:23.3.7: vippasannāni kho te āvuso indriyāni, parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto,
pli-tv-kd1:23.3.8: kaṃ 'si tvaṃ āvuso uddissa pabbajito, ko vā te satthā, kassa vā tvaṃ dhammaṃ rocesīti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:23.4.1: atth' āvuso mahāsamaṇo Sakyaputto Sakyakulā pabbajito, tāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ uddissa pabbajito, so ca me bhagavā satthā, tassa cāhaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ rocemīti.
pli-tv-kd1:23.4.3: ahaṃ kho āvuso navo acirapabbajito adhunāgato imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ, na t' āhaṃ sakkomi vitthārena dhammaṃ desetuṃ, api ca te saṃkhittena atthaṃ vakkhāmīti.
pli-tv-kd1:23.4.4: atha kho Sāriputto paribbājako āyasmantaṃ Assajiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:23.5.1: atha kho āyasmā Assaji Sāriputtassa paribbājakassa imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ abhāsi:
pli-tv-kd1:23.5.6: atha kho Sāriputtassa paribbājakassa imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ sutvā virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
pli-tv-kd1:23.5.7: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman ti.
pli-tv-kd1:23.5.8: es' eva dhammo yadi tāvad eva
pli-tv-kd1:23.6.1: atha kho Sāriputto paribbājako yena Moggallāno paribbājako ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-kd1:23.6.2: addasa kho Moggallāno paribbājako Sāriputtaṃ paribbājakaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ, disvāna Sāriputtaṃ paribbājakaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:23.6.3: vippasannāni kho te āvuso indriyāni, parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto,
pli-tv-kd1:23.6.4: kacci nu tvaṃ āvuso amataṃ adhigato 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:23.6.6: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ āvuso amataṃ adhigato 'ti. ||6||
pli-tv-kd1:23.7.1: idhāhaṃ āvuso addasaṃ Assajiṃ bhikkhuṃ Rājagahe piṇḍāya carantaṃ pāsādikena abhikkantena paṭikkantena ālokitena vilokitena sammiñjitena pasāritena okkhittacakkhuṃ iriyāpathasampannaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:23.7.3: ye vata loke arahanto vā arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpannā, ayaṃ tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ aññataro,
pli-tv-kd1:23.7.4: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṃkamitvā puccheyyaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:23.7.5: kaṃ 'si tvaṃ āvuso uddissa pabbajito, ko vā te satthā, kassa vā tvaṃ dhammaṃ rocesīti. ||7||
pli-tv-kd1:23.8.2: akālo kho imaṃ bhikkhuṃ pucchituṃ, antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho piṇḍāya carati. yaṃ nūnāhaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ piṭṭhito-piṭṭhito anubandheyyaṃ atthikehi upaññātaṃ maggan ti.

pli-tv-kd1:23.8.5: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho ahaṃ āvuso Assajiṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avocaṃ:

pli-tv-kd1:23.9.1: kaṃ 'si tvaṃ āvuso uddissa pabbajito, ko vā te satthā, kassa vā tvaṃ dhammaṃ rocesīti. ||8||
pli-tv-kd1:23.9.2: atth' āvuso mahāsamaṇo Sakyaputto Sakyakulā pabbajito, tāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ uddissa pabbajito, so ca me bhagavā satthā, tassa cāhaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ rocemīti.
