pli-tv-kd1:23.10.6: atha kho Moggallānassa paribbājakassa imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ sutvā virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
pli-tv-kd1:23.10.7: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman ti.
pli-tv-kd1:23.10.8: es' eva dhammo yadi tāvad eva
pli-tv-kd1:24.1.1: atha kho Moggallāno paribbājako Sāriputtaṃ paribbājakaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:24.1.2: gacchāma mayaṃ āvuso bhagavato santike, so no bhagavā satthā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:24.1.3: imāni kho āvuso aḍḍhateyyāni paribbājakasatāni amhe nissāya amhe sampassantā idha viharanti, te pi tāva apalokāma,
pli-tv-kd1:24.1.5: atha kho Sāriputtamoggallānā yena te paribbājakā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā te paribbājake etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:24.1.6: gacchāma mayaṃ āvuso bhagavato santike, so no bhagavā satthā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:24.1.7: mayaṃ āyasmante nissāya āyasmante sampassantā idha viharāma, sace āyasmantā mahāsamaṇe brahmacariyaṃ carissanti, sabbeva mayaṃ mahāsamaṇe brahmacariyaṃ carissāmā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:24.2.1: atha kho Sāriputtamoggallānā yena Sañjayo paribbājako ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā Sañjayaṃ paribbājakaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:24.2.2: gacchāma mayaṃ āvuso bhagavato santike, so no bhagavā satthā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:24.2.3: alaṃ āvuso mā agamittha, sabbeva tayo imaṃ gaṇaṃ pariharissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:24.2.5: tatiyam pi kho Sāriputtamoggallānā Sañjayaṃ paribbājakaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:24.2.6: gacchāma mayaṃ āvuso bhagavato santike, so no bhagavā satthā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:24.2.7: alaṃ avuso mā agamittha, sabbeva tayo imaṃ gaṇaṃ pariharissāmā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:24.3.1: atha kho Sāriputtamoggallānā tāni aḍḍhateyyāni paribbājakasatāni ādāya yena Veḷuvanaṃ ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu,
pli-tv-kd1:24.3.2: Sañjayassa pana paribbājakassa tatth' eva uṇhaṃ lohitaṃ mukhato uggacchi.
pli-tv-kd1:24.3.3: addasa kho bhagavā te Sāriputtamoggallāne dūrato 'va āgacchante, disvāna bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:24.3.4: ete bhikkhave dve sahāyakā āgacchanti Kolito Upatisso ca,
pli-tv-kd1:24.3.5: etaṃ me sāvakayugaṃ bhavissati aggaṃ bhaddayugan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:24.4.1: atha kho Sāriputtamoggallānā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:24.4.2: labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyāma upasampadan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:24.4.4: svākkhāto dhammo, caratha brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:24.5.1: tena kho pana samayena abhiññātā-abhiññātā Māgadhikā kulaputtā bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caranti.
pli-tv-kd1:24.5.3: aputtakatāya paṭipanno samaṇo Gotamo, vedhavyāya paṭipanno samaṇo Gotamo, kulupacchedāya paṭipanno samaṇo Gotamo. idāni anena jaṭilasahassaṃ pabbājitaṃ, imāni ca aḍḍhateyyāni paribbājakasatāni Sañjayāni pabbājitāni,
pli-tv-kd1:24.5.4: ime ca abhiññātā-abhiññātā Māgadhikā kulaputtā samaṇe Gotame brahmacariyaṃ carantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:24.5.5: api 'ssu bhikkhū disvā imāya gāthāya codenti:
pli-tv-kd1:24.6.1: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:24.6.2: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:24.6.3: na bhikkhave so saddo ciraṃ bhavissati, sattāham eva bhavissati, sattāhassa accayena antaradhāyissati.
pli-tv-kd1:24.6.4: tena hi bhikkhave ye tumhe imāya gāthāya codenti:
pli-tv-kd1:24.7.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā bhikkhū disvā imāya gāthāya codenti:
pli-tv-kd1:24.7.6: bhikkhū te manusse imāya gāthāya paṭicodenti:
pli-tv-kd1:24.7.11: manussā dhammena kira samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā nenti no adhammenā 'ti sattāham eva so saddo ahosi, sattāhassa accayena antaradhāyi. ||7||
pli-tv-kd1:25.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū anupajjhāyakā anovadiyamānā ananusāsiyamānā dunnivatthā duppārutā anākappasampannā piṇḍāya caranti. te
pli-tv-kd1:25.1.2: manussānaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ upari bhojane pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmenti, upari khādaniye pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmenti, upari sāyaniye pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmenti, upari pāniye pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmenti,
pli-tv-kd1:25.1.3: sāmaṃ sūpam pi odanam pi viññāpetvā bhuñjanti,
pli-tv-kd1:25.2.2: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā dunnivatthā duppārutā anākappasampannā piṇḍāya carissanti,
pli-tv-kd1:25.2.3: manussānaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ upari bhojane pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmessanti, upari khādaniye pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmessanti, upari sāyaniye pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmessanti, upari pāniye pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmessanti,
pli-tv-kd1:25.2.4: sāmaṃ sūpam pi odanam pi viññāpetvā bhuñjissanti,
pli-tv-kd1:25.2.5: bhattagge pi uccāsaddā mahāsaddā viharissanti, seyyathāpi brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇabhojane 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:25.3.1: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.3.2: ye te bhikkhū appicchā santuṭṭhā lajjino kukkuccakā sikkhākāmā, te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd1:25.3.3: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū dunnivatthā duppārutā anākappasampannā piṇḍāya carissanti,
pli-tv-kd1:25.3.4: manussānaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ upari bhojane pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmessanti, upari khādaniye pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmessanti, upari sāyaniye pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmessanti, upari pāniye pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmessanti,
pli-tv-kd1:25.3.5: sāmaṃ sūpam pi odanam pi viññāpetvā bhuñjissanti,
pli-tv-kd1:25.4.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd1:25.4.4: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū dunnivatthā duppārutā anākappasampannā piṇḍāya caranti manussānaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ upari bhojane pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmenti, upari khādaniye pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmenti, upari sāyaniye pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmenti, upari pāniye pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmenti, sāmaṃ sūpam pi odanam pi viññāpetvā bhuñjanti, bhattagge pi uccāsaddā mahāsaddā viharantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:25.5.2: ananucchaviyaṃ bhikkhave tesaṃ moghapurisānaṃ ananulomikaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.5.3: kathaṃ hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā dunnivatthā duppārutā anākappasampannā piṇḍāya carissanti, manussānaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ upari bhojane pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmessanti upari khādaniye pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmessanti, upari sāyaniye pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmessanti, upari pāniye pi uttiṭṭhapattaṃ upanāmessanti, sāmaṃ sūpam pi odanam pi viññāpetvā bhuñjissanti, bhattagge pi uccāsaddā mahāsaddā viharissanti.
pli-tv-kd1:25.5.4: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya,
pli-tv-kd1:25.5.5: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave appasannānañ c' eva appasādāya, pasannānañ ca ekaccānaṃ aññathattāyā 'ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd1:25.6.1: atha kho bhagavā te bhikkhū anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā dubbharatāya dupposatāya mahicchatāya asantuṭṭhiyā saṃgaṇikāya kosajjassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsitvā anekapariyāyena subharatāya suposatāya appicchassa santuṭṭhassa sallekhassa dhutassa pāsādikassa apacayassa viriyārambhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsitvā bhikkhūnaṃ tadanucchavikaṃ tadanulomikaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:25.6.3: upajjhāyo bhikkhave saddhivihārikamhi puttacittaṃ upaṭṭhāpessati, saddhivihāriko upajjhāyamhi pitucittaṃ upaṭṭhāpessati.
pli-tv-kd1:25.6.4: evaṃ te aññamaññaṃ sagāravā sappatissā sabhāgavuttino viharantā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissanti. ||6||
pli-tv-kd1:25.7.1: evañ ca pana bhikkhave upajjhāyo gahetabbo:
pli-tv-kd1:25.7.2: ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd1:25.7.6: sāhū 'ti vā, lahū 'ti vā, opāyikan ti vā, paṭirūpan ti vā, pāsādikena sampādehīti vā kāyena viññāpeti, vācāya viññāpeti, kāyena vācāya viññāpeti, gahito hoti upajjhāyo,
pli-tv-kd1:25.7.7: na kāyena viññāpeti, na vācāya viññāpeti, na kāyenavācāya viññāpeti, na gahito hoti upajjhāyo. ||7||
pli-tv-kd1:25.8.3.1: kālass' eva uṭṭhāya upāhanā omuñcitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā dantakaṭṭhaṃ dātabbaṃ, mukhodakaṃ dātabbaṃ, āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.8.4: sace yāgu hoti, bhājanaṃ dhovitvā yāgu upanāmetabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:25.8.5: yāguṃ pītassa udakaṃ datvā bhājanaṃ paṭiggahetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena dhovitvā paṭisāmetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.8.7: sace so deso uklāpo hoti, so deso sammajjitabbo. ||8||
pli-tv-kd1:25.9.1: sace upajjhāyo gāmaṃ pavisitukāmo hoti, nivāsanaṃ dātabbaṃ, paṭinivāsanaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ, kāyabandhanaṃ dātabbaṃ, saguṇaṃ katvā saṃghāṭiyo dātabbā, dhovitvā patto saudako dātabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:25.9.2: sace upajjhāyo pacchāsamaṇaṃ ākaṅkhati, timaṇḍalaṃ paṭicchādentena parimaṇḍalaṃ nivāsetvā kāyabandhanaṃ bandhitvā saguṇaṃ katvā saṃghāṭiyo pārupitvā gaṇṭhikaṃ paṭimuñcitvā dhovitvā pattaṃ gahetvā upajjhāyassa pacchāsamaṇena hotabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.10.1: nātidūre gantabbaṃ, na accāsanne gantabbaṃ. pattapariyāpannaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ. ||9||
pli-tv-kd1:25.10.2: na upajjhāyassa bhaṇamānassa antarantarā kathā opātetabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:25.10.4: nivattantena paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipitabbaṃ, paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ, paṭinivāsanaṃ dātabbaṃ, nivāsanaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.10.5: sace cīvaraṃ sinnaṃ hoti, muhuttaṃ uṇhe otāpetabbaṃ, na ca uṇhe cīvaraṃ nidahitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.10.6: cīvaraṃ saṃharitabbaṃ. cīvaraṃ saṃharantena caturaṅgulaṃ kaṇṇaṃ ussāretvā cīvaraṃ saṃharitabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:25.10.9: sace piṇḍapāto hoti upajjhāyo ca bhuñjitukāmo hoti, udakaṃ datvā piṇḍapāto upanāmetabbo. ||10||
pli-tv-kd1:25.11.2: bhuttāvissa udakaṃ datvā pattaṃ paṭiggahetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena dhovitvā vodakaṃ katvā muhuttaṃ uṇhe otāpetabbo, na ca uṇhe patto nidahitabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:25.11.4: pattaṃ nikkhipantena ekena hatthena pattaṃ gahetvā ekena hatthena heṭṭhāmañcaṃ vā heṭṭhāpīṭhaṃ vā parāmasitvā patto nikkhipitabbo,
pli-tv-kd1:25.11.5: na ca anantarahitāya bhūmiyā patto nikkhipitabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:25.11.6: cīvaraṃ nikkhipantena ekena hatthena cīvaraṃ gahetvā ekena hatthena cīvaravaṃsaṃ vā cīvararajjuṃ vā pamajjitvā pārato antaṃ orato bhogaṃ katvā cīvaraṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.11.7: upajjhāyamhi vuṭṭhite āsanaṃ uddharitabbaṃ, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ paṭisāmetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.11.8: sace so deso uklāpo hoti, so deso sammajjitabbo. ||11||
pli-tv-kd1:25.12.1: sace upajjhāyo nahāyitukāmo hoti, nahānaṃ paṭiyādetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.12.2: sace sītena attho hoti, sītaṃ paṭiyādetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.12.3: sace uṇhena attho hoti, uṇhaṃ paṭiyādetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.12.4: sace upajjhāyo jantāgharaṃ pavisitukāmo hoti, cuṇṇaṃ sannetabbaṃ, mattikā temetabbā, jantāgharapīṭhaṃ ādāya upajjhāyassa piṭṭhito-piṭṭhito gantvā jantāgharapīṭhaṃ datvā cīvaraṃ paṭiggahetvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ, cuṇṇaṃ dātabbaṃ, mattikā dātabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:25.12.6: jantāgharaṃ pavisantena mattikāya mukhaṃ makkhetvā purato ca pacchato ca paṭicchādetvā jantāgharaṃ pavisitabbaṃ. ||12||
pli-tv-kd1:25.13.4: jantāgharā nikkhamantena jantāgharapīṭhaṃ ādāya purato ca pacchato ca paṭicchādetvā jantāgharā nikkhamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.13.6: nahātena paṭhamataraṃ uttaritvā attano gattaṃ vodakaṃ katvā nivāsetvā upajjhāyassa gattato udakaṃ pamajjitabbaṃ, nivāsanaṃ dātabbaṃ, saṃghāṭi dātabbā, jantāgharapīṭhaṃ ādāya paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipitabbaṃ. upajjhāyo pāniyena pucchitabbo. ||13||
pli-tv-kd1:25.14.3.1: yasmiṃ vihāre upajjhāyo viharati, sace so vihāro uklāpo hoti, sace ussahati, sodhetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:25.14.4: vihāraṃ sodhentena paṭhamaṃ pattacīvaraṃ nīharitvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.15.1: mañco nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena asaṃghaṭṭantena kavāṭapiṭṭhaṃ nīharitvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:25.15.2: pīṭhaṃ nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena asaṃghaṭṭantena kavāṭapiṭṭhaṃ nīharitvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.15.6: bhummattharaṇaṃ yathāpaññattaṃ sallakkhetvā nīharitvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.15.7: sace vihāre santānakaṃ hoti, ullokā paṭhamaṃ ohāretabbaṃ. ālokasandhikaṇṇabhāgā pamajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:25.15.8: sace gerukaparikammakatā bhitti kaṇṇakitā hoti, coḷakaṃ temetvā pīḷetvā pamajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:25.15.9: sace kāḷavaṇṇakatā bhūmi kaṇṇakitā hoti, coḷakaṃ temetvā pīḷetvā pamajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:25.15.10: sace akatā hoti bhūmi, udakena parippositvā sammajjitabbā
pli-tv-kd1:25.16.1: bhummattharaṇaṃ otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā atiharitvā yathāpaññattaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.16.2: mañcapaṭipādakā otāpetvā pamajjitvā atiharitvā yathāṭṭhāne ṭhapetabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:25.16.3: mañco otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena asaṃghaṭṭantena kavāṭapiṭṭhaṃ atiharitvā yathāpaññattaṃ paññāpetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:25.16.4: pīṭhaṃ otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena asaṃghaṭṭantena kavāṭapiṭṭhaṃ atiharitvā yathāpaññattaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.16.5: bhisibimbohanaṃ otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā atiharitvā yathāpaññattaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.16.6: nisīdanapaccattharaṇaṃ otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā atiharitvā yathāpaññattaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.16.7: kheḷamallako otāpetvā pamajjitvā atiharitvā yathāṭṭhāne ṭhapetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:25.16.8: apassenaphalakaṃ otāpetvā pamajjitvā atiharitvā yathāṭṭhāne ṭhapetabbaṃ. ||16||
pli-tv-kd1:25.17.2: pattaṃ nikkhipantena ekena hatthena pattaṃ gahetvā ekena hatthena heṭṭhāmañcaṃ vā heṭṭhāpīṭhaṃ vā parāmasitvā patto nikkhipitabbo,
pli-tv-kd1:25.17.3: na ca anantarahitāya bhūmiyā patto nikkhipitabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:25.17.4: cīvaraṃ nikkhipantena ekena hatthena cīvaraṃ gahetvā ekena hatthena cīvaravaṃsaṃ vā cīvararajjuṃ vā pamajjitvā pārato antaṃ orato bhogaṃ katvā cīvaraṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ. ||17||
pli-tv-kd1:25.18.1: sace puratthimā sarajā vātā vāyanti, puratthimā vātapānā thaketabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:25.18.2: sace pacchimā sarajā vātā vāyanti, pacchimā vātapānā thaketabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:25.18.3: sace uttarā sarajā vātā vāyanti, uttarā vātapānā thaketabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:25.18.4: sace dakkhiṇā sarajā vātā vāyanti, dakkhiṇā vātapānā thaketabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:25.18.5: sace sītakālo hoti, divā vātapānā vivaritabbā, rattiṃ thaketabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:25.18.6: sace uṇhakālo hoti, divā vātapānā thaketabbā, rattiṃ vivaritabbā. ||18||
pli-tv-kd1:25.19.1: sace pariveṇaṃ uklāpaṃ hoti, pariveṇaṃ sammajjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.19.2: sace koṭṭhako uklāpo hoti, koṭṭhako sammajjitabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:25.19.3: sace upaṭṭhānasālā uklāpā hoti, upaṭṭhānasālā sammajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:25.19.4: sace aggisālā uklāpā hoti, aggisālā sammajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:25.19.5: sace vaccakuṭī uklāpā hoti, vaccakuṭī sammajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:25.19.6: sace pāniyaṃ na hoti, pāniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.19.7: sace paribhojaniyaṃ na hoti, paribhojaniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:25.19.8: sace ācamanakumbhiyā udakaṃ na hoti, ācamanakumbhiyā udakaṃ āsiñcitabbaṃ. ||19||
pli-tv-kd1:25.20.1: sace upajjhāyassa anabhirati uppannā hoti, saddhivihārikena vūpakāsetabbā vūpakāsāpetabbā dhammakathā vāssa kātabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:25.20.2: sace upajjhāyassa kukkuccaṃ uppannaṃ hoti, saddhivihārikena vinodetabbaṃ vinodāpetabbaṃ dhammakathā vāssa kātabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:25.20.3: sace upajjhāyassa diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti, saddhivihārikena vivecetabbaṃ vivecāpetabbaṃ dhammakathā vāssa kātabbā. ||20||
pli-tv-kd1:25.21.1: sace upajjhāyo garudhammaṃ ajjhāpanno hoti parivāsāraho, saddhivihārikena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:25.21.2: kin ti nu kho saṃgho upajjhāyassa parivāsaṃ dadeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:25.21.3: sace upajjhāyo mūlāya paṭikassanāraho hoti, saddhivihārikena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:25.21.4: kin ti nu kho saṃgho upajjhāyaṃ mūlāya paṭikasseyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:25.21.5: sace upajjhāyo mānattāraho hoti, saddhivihārikena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:25.21.6: kin ti nu kho saṃgho upajjhāyassa mānattaṃ dadeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:25.21.7: sace upajjhāyo abbhānāraho hoti, saddhivihārikena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:25.21.8: kin ti nu kho saṃgho upajjhāyaṃ abbheyyā 'ti. ||21||
pli-tv-kd1:25.22.1: sace saṃgho upajjhāyassa kammaṃ kattukāmo hoti tajjaniyaṃ vā nissayaṃ vā pabbājaniyaṃ vā paṭisāraṇiyaṃ vā ukkhepaniyaṃ vā, saddhivihārikena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:25.22.2: kin ti nu kho saṃgho upajjhāyassa kammaṃ na kareyya lahukāya vā pariṇāmeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:25.22.3: kataṃ vā pan' assa hoti saṃghena kammaṃ tajjaniyaṃ vā nissayaṃ vā pabbājaniyaṃ vā paṭisāraṇiyaṃ vā ukkhepaniyaṃ vā, saddhivihārikena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:25.22.4: kin ti nu kho upajjhāyo sammāvatteyya lomaṃ pāteyya netthāraṃ vatteyya, saṃgho taṃ kammaṃ paṭippassambheyyā 'ti. ||22||
pli-tv-kd1:25.23.1: sace upajjhāyassa cīvaraṃ dhovitabbaṃ hoti, saddhivihārikena dhovitabbaṃ ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:25.23.2: kin ti nu kho upajjhāyassa cīvaraṃ dhoviyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:25.23.3: sace upajjhāyassa cīvaraṃ kātabbaṃ hoti, saddhivihārikena kātabbaṃ ussukkaṃ vā katabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:25.23.4: kin ti nu kho upajjhāyassa cīvaraṃ kariyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:25.23.5: sace upajjhāyassa rajanaṃ pacitabbaṃ hoti, saddhivihārikena pacitabbaṃ ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:25.23.6: kin ti nu kho upajjhāyassa rajanaṃ paciyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:25.23.7: sace upajjhāyassa cīvaraṃ rajitabbaṃ hoti, saddhivihārikena rajitabbaṃ ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:25.23.8: kin ti nu kho upajjhāyassa cīvaraṃ rajiyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:25.23.9: cīvaraṃ rajantena sādhukaṃ saṃparivattakaṃ-saṃparivattakaṃ rajitabbaṃ na ca acchinne theve pakkamitabbaṃ. ||23||
pli-tv-kd1:25.24.1: na upajjhāyaṃ anāpucchā ekaccassa patto dātabbo, na ekaccassa patto paṭiggahetabbo,
pli-tv-kd1:25.24.2: na ekaccassa cīvaraṃ dātabbaṃ, na ekaccassa cīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:25.24.3: na ekaccassa parikkhāro dātabbo, na ekaccassa parikkhāro paṭiggahetabbo,
pli-tv-kd1:25.24.4: na ekaccassa kesā chedātabbā, na ekaccena kesā chedāpetabbā,
pli-tv-kd1:25.24.5: na ekaccassa parikammaṃ kātabbaṃ, na ekaccena parikammaṃ kārāpetabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:25.24.6: na ekaccassa veyyāvacco kātabbo, na ekaccena veyyāvacco kārāpetabbo,
pli-tv-kd1:25.24.7: na ekaccassa pacchāsamaṇena hotabbaṃ, na ekacco pacchāsamaṇo ādātabbo,
pli-tv-kd1:25.24.8: na ekaccassa piṇḍapāto nīharitabbo, na ekaccena piṇḍapāto nīharāpetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:25.24.12: sace upajjhāyo gilāno hoti, yāvajīvaṃ upaṭṭhātabbo,
pli-tv-kd1:26.1.3: upajjhāyena bhikkhave saddhivihāriko saṃgahetabbo anuggahetabbo uddesena paripucchāya ovādena anusāsaniyā.
pli-tv-kd1:26.1.4: sace upajjhāyassa patto hoti, saddhivihārikassa patto na hoti, upajjhāyena saddhivihārikassa patto dātabbo ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:26.1.5: kin ti nu kho saddhivihārikassa patto uppajjiyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:26.1.6: sace upajjhāyassa cīvaraṃ hoti, saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ na hoti, upajjhāyena saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ dātabbaṃ ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:26.1.7: kin ti nu kho saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ uppajjiyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:26.1.8: sace upajjhāyassa parikkhāro hoti, saddhivihārikassa parikkhāro na hoti, upajjhāyena saddhivihārikassa parikkhāro dātabbo ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:26.1.9: kin ti nu kho saddhivihārikassa parikkhāro uppajjiyethā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:26.2.1: sace saddhivihāriko gilāno hoti, kālass' eva uṭṭhāya dantakaṭṭhaṃ dātabbaṃ, mukhodakaṃ dātabbaṃ, āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:26.2.2: sace yāgu hoti, bhājanaṃ dhovitvā yāgu upanāmetabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:26.2.3: yāguṃ pītassa udakaṃ datvā bhājanaṃ paṭiggahetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena dhovitvā paṭisāmetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:26.2.5: sace so deso uklāpo hoti, so deso sammajjitabbo. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:26.3.1: sace saddhivihāriko gāmaṃ pavisitukāmo hoti, nivāsanaṃ dātabbaṃ, paṭinivāsanaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ, kāyabandhanaṃ dātabbaṃ, saguṇaṃ katvā saṃghāṭiyo dātabbā, dhovitvā patto saudako dātabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:26.3.2: ettāvatā nivattissatīti āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipitabbaṃ, paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ, paṭinivāsanaṃ dātabbaṃ, nivāsanaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:26.3.3: sace cīvaraṃ sinnaṃ hoti, muhuttaṃ uṇhe otāpetabbaṃ, na ca uṇhe cīvaraṃ nidahitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:26.3.4: cīvaraṃ saṃharitabbaṃ. cīvaraṃ saṃharantena caturaṅgulaṃ kaṇṇaṃ ussāretvā cīvaraṃ saṃharitabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:26.3.7: sace piṇḍapāto hoti saddhivihāriko ca bhuñjitukāmo hoti, udakaṃ datvā piṇḍapāto upanāmetabbo. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:26.4.2: bhuttāvissa udakaṃ datvā pattaṃ paṭiggahetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena dhovitvā vodakaṃ katvā muhuttaṃ uṇhe otāpetabbo, na ca uṇhe patto nidahitabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:26.4.4: pattaṃ nikkhipantena ekena hatthena pattaṃ gahetvā ekena hatthena heṭṭhāmañcaṃ vā heṭṭhāpīṭhaṃ vā parāmasitvā patto nikkhipitabbo,
pli-tv-kd1:26.4.5: na ca anantarahitāya bhūmiyā patto nikkhipitabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:26.4.6: cīvaraṃ nikkhipantena ekena hatthena cīvaraṃ gahetvā ekena hatthena cīvaravaṃsaṃ vā cīvararajjuṃ vā pamajjitvā pārato antaṃ orato bhogaṃ katvā cīvaraṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:26.4.7: saddhivihārikamhi vuṭṭhite āsanaṃ uddharitabbaṃ, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ paṭisāmetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:26.4.8: sace so deso uklāpo hoti, so deso sammajjitabbo. ||4||
pli-tv-kd1:26.5.1: sace saddhivihāriko nahāyitukāmo hoti, nahānaṃ paṭiyādetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:26.5.2: sace sītena attho hoti, sītaṃ paṭiyādetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:26.5.3: sace uṇhena attho hoti, uṇhaṃ paṭiyādetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:26.5.4: sace saddhivihāriko jantāgharaṃ pavisitukāmo hoti, cuṇṇaṃ sannetabbaṃ, mattikā temetabbā, jantāgharapīṭhaṃ ādāya gantvā jantāgharapīṭhaṃ datvā cīvaraṃ paṭiggahetvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ, cuṇṇaṃ dātabbaṃ, mattikā dātabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:26.5.6: jantāgharaṃ pavisantena mattikāya mukhaṃ makkhetvā purato ca pacchato ca paṭicchādetvā jantāgharaṃ pavisitabbam. ||5||
pli-tv-kd1:26.6.4: jantāgharā nikkhamantena jantāgharapīṭhaṃ ādāya purato ca pacchato ca paṭicchādetvā jantāgharā nikkhamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:26.6.6: nahātena paṭhamataraṃ uttaritvā attano gattaṃ vodakaṃ katvā nivāsetvā saddhivihārikassa gattato udakaṃ pamajjitabbaṃ, nivāsanaṃ dātabbaṃ, saṃghāṭi dātabbā,
pli-tv-kd1:26.6.7: jantāgharapīṭhaṃ ādāya paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ, pādodakaṃ padapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:26.7.1: yasmiṃ vihāre saddhivihāriko viharati, sace so vihāro uklāpo hoti, sace ussahati, sodhetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:26.7.2: vihāraṃ sodhentena paṭhamaṃ pattacīvaraṃ nīharitvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ . . . (=
pli-tv-kd1:26.7.42: sace ācamanakumbhiyā udakaṃ na hoti, ācamanakumbhiyā udakaṃ āsiñcitabbaṃ. ||7||
pli-tv-kd1:26.8.1: sace saddhivihārikassa anabhirati uppannā hoti, upajjhāyena vūpakāsetabbā vūpakāsāpetabbā dhammakathā vāssa kātabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:26.8.2: sace saddhivihārikassa kukkuccaṃ uppannaṃ hoti, upajjhāyena vinodetabbaṃ vinodāpetabbaṃ dhammakathā vāssa kātabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:26.8.3: sace saddhivihārikassa diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti, upajjhāyena vivecetabbaṃ vivecāpetabbaṃ dhammakathā vāssa kātabbā. ||8||
pli-tv-kd1:26.9.1: sace saddhivihāriko garudhammaṃ ajjhāpanno hoti parivāsāraho, upajjhāyena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:26.9.2: kin ti nu kho saṃgho saddhivihārikassa parivāsaṃ dadeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:26.9.3: sace saddhivihāriko mūlāya paṭikassanāraho hoti, upajjhāyena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:26.9.4: kin ti nu kho saṃgho saddhivihārikaṃ mūlāya paṭikasseyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:26.9.5: sace saddhivihāriko mānattāraho hoti, upajjhāyena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:26.9.6: kin ti nu kho saṃgho saddhivihārikassa mānattaṃ dadeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:26.9.7: sace saddhivihāriko abbhānāraho hoti, upajjhāyena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:26.9.8: kin ti nu kho saṃgho saddhivihārikaṃ abbheyyā 'ti. ||9||
pli-tv-kd1:26.10.1: sace saṃgho saddhivihārikassa kammaṃ kattukāmo hoti tajjaniyaṃ vā nissayaṃ vā pabbājaniyaṃ vā paṭisāraṇiyaṃ vā ukkhepaniyaṃ vā, upajjhāyena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:26.10.2: kin ti nu kho saṃgho saddhivihārikassa kammaṃ na kareyya lahukāya vā pariṇāmeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:26.10.3: kataṃ vā pan' assa hoti saṃghena kammaṃ tajjaniyaṃ vā nissayaṃ vā pabbājaniyaṃ vā paṭisāraṇiyaṃ vā ukkhepaniyaṃ vā, upajjhāyena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:26.10.4: kin ti nu kho saddhivihāriko sammāvatteyya lomaṃ pāteyya netthāraṃ vatteyya, saṃgho taṃ kammaṃ paṭippassambheyyā 'ti. ||10||
pli-tv-kd1:26.11.1: sace saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ dhovitabbaṃ hoti, upajjhāyena ācikkhitabbaṃ evaṃ dhoveyyāsīti, ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:26.11.2: kin ti nu kho saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ dhoviyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:26.11.3: sace saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ kātabbaṃ hoti, upajjhāyena ācikkhitabbaṃ evaṃ kareyyāsīti, ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:26.11.4: kin ti nu kho saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ kariyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:26.11.5: sace saddhivihārikassa rajanaṃ pacitabbaṃ hoti, upajjhāyena ācikkhitabbaṃ evaṃ paceyyāsīti, ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:26.11.6: kin ti nu kho saddhivihārikassa rajanaṃ paciyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:26.11.7: sace saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ rajitabbaṃ hoti, upajjhāyena ācikkhitabbaṃ evaṃ rajeyyāsīti, ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:26.11.8: kin ti nu kho saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ rajiyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:26.11.11: sace saddhivihāriko gilāno hoti, yāvajīvaṃ upaṭṭhātabbo, vuṭṭhānassa āgametabban ti. ||11||
pli-tv-kd1:27.1.1: tena kho pana samayena saddhivihārikā upajjhāyesu na sammāvattanti.
pli-tv-kd1:27.1.2: ye te bhikkhū appicchā, te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd1:27.1.3: kathaṃ hi nāma saddhivihārikā upajjhāyesu na sammāvattissantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:27.1.4: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:27.1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave saddhivihārikā upajjhāyesu na sammāvattantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:27.1.8: hi nāma bhikkhave saddhivihārikā upajjhāyesu na sammāvattissantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:27.1.11: na bhikkhave saddhivihārikena upajjhāyamhi na sammāvattitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:27.2.5: paṇāmemi tan ti vā, mā yidha paṭikkamīti vā, nīhara te pattacīvaran ti vā, nāhaṃ tayā upaṭṭhātabbo 'ti vā kāyena viññāpeti, vācāya viññāpeti, kāyena vācāya viññāpeti, paṇāmito hoti saddhivihāriko.
pli-tv-kd1:27.2.6: na kāyena viññāpeti, na vācāya viññāpeti, na kāyena vācāya viññāpeti, na paṇāmito hoti saddhivihāriko 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:27.3.1: tena kho pana samayena saddhivihārikā paṇāmitā na khamāpenti.
pli-tv-kd1:27.4.1: tena kho pana samayena upajjhāyā khamāpiyamānā na khamanti.
pli-tv-kd1:27.4.5: saddhivihārikā pakkamanti pi, vibbhamanti pi, titthiyesu pi saṃkamanti.
pli-tv-kd1:27.5.1: tena kho pana samayena upajjhāyā sammāvattantaṃ paṇāmenti, asammāvattantaṃ na paṇāmenti.
pli-tv-kd1:27.5.5: na ca bhikkhave asammāvattanto na paṇāmetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:27.6.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato saddhivihāriko paṇāmetabbo:
pli-tv-kd1:27.6.2: upajjhāyamhi nādhimattaṃ pemaṃ hoti, nādhimatto pasādo hoti, nādhimattā hirī hoti, nādhimatto gāravo hoti, nādhimattā bhāvanā hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:27.6.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgato saddhivihāriko paṇāmetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:27.6.4: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato saddhivihāriko na paṇāmetabbo:
pli-tv-kd1:27.6.5: upajjhāyamhi adhimattaṃ pemaṃ hoti, adhimatto pasādo hoti, adhimattā hirī hoti, adhimatto gāravo hoti, adhimattā bhāvanā hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:27.6.6: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgato saddhivihāriko na paṇāmetabbo. ||6||
pli-tv-kd1:27.7.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato saddhivihāriko alaṃ paṇāmetuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:27.7.2: upajjhāyamhi nādhimattaṃ pemaṃ hoti . . . nādhimattā bhāvanā hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:27.7.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgato saddhivihāriko alaṃ paṇāmetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:27.7.4: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato saddhivihāriko nālaṃ paṇāmetuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:27.7.5: upajjhāyamhi adhimattaṃ pemaṃ hoti . . . adhimattā bhāvanā hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:27.7.6: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgato saddhivihāriko nālaṃ paṇāmetuṃ. ||7||
pli-tv-kd1:27.8.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgataṃ saddhivihārikaṃ apaṇāmento upajjhāyo sātisāro hoti, paṇāmento anatisāro hoti:
pli-tv-kd1:27.8.2: upajjhāyamhi nādhimattaṃ pemaṃ hoti . . . nādhimattā bhāvanā hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:27.8.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ saddhivihārikaṃ apaṇāmento upajjhāyo sātisāro hoti, paṇāmento anatisāro hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:27.8.4: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgataṃ saddhivihārikaṃ paṇāmento upajjhāyo sātisāro hoti, apaṇāmento anatisāro hoti:
pli-tv-kd1:27.8.5: upajjhāyamhi adhimattaṃ pemaṃ hoti . . . adhimattā bhāvanā hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:27.8.6: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ saddhivihārikaṃ paṇāmento upajjhāyo sātisāro hoti, apaṇāmento anatisāro hotīti. ||8||27||
pli-tv-kd1:28.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro brāhmaṇo bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā pabbajjaṃ yāci,
pli-tv-kd1:28.1.3: so bhikkhūsu pabbajjaṃ alabhamāno kiso ahosi lūkho dubbaṇṇo uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajāto dhamanisanthatagatto.
pli-tv-kd1:28.1.4: addasa kho bhagavā taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kisaṃ lūkhaṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātaṃ dhamanisanthatagattaṃ, disvāna bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:28.1.5: kiṃ nu kho so bhikkhave brāhmaṇo kiso lūkho dubbaṇṇo uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajāto dhamanisanthatagatto 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:28.1.6: eso bhante brāhmaṇo bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā pabbajjaṃ yāci,
pli-tv-kd1:28.1.8: so bhikkhūsu pabbajjaṃ alabhamāno kiso lūkho dubbaṇṇo uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajāto dhamanisanthatagatto 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:28.2.2: ko nu kho bhikkhave tassa brāhmaṇassa adhikāraṃ saratīti.
pli-tv-kd1:28.2.3: evaṃ vutte āyasmā Sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:28.2.4: ahaṃ kho bhante tassa brāhmaṇassa adhikāraṃ sarāmīti.
pli-tv-kd1:28.2.5: kiṃ pana tvaṃ Sāriputta tassa brāhmaṇassa adhikāraṃ sarasīti.
pli-tv-kd1:28.2.6: idha me bhante so brāhmaṇo Rājagahe piṇḍāya carantassa kaṭacchubhikkhaṃ dāpesi,
pli-tv-kd1:28.2.7: imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante tassa brāhmaṇassa adhikāraṃ sarāmīti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:28.3.1: sādhu sādhu Sāriputta, kataññuno hi Sāriputta sappurisā katavedino.
pli-tv-kd1:28.3.2: tena hi tvaṃ Sāriputta taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ pabbājehi upasampādehīti.
pli-tv-kd1:28.3.3: kathāhaṃ bhante taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ pabbājemi upasampādemīti.
pli-tv-kd1:28.3.4: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:28.3.5: yā sā bhikkhave mayā tīhi saraṇagamanehi upasampadā anuññātā, tāhaṃ ajjatagge paṭikkhipāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:28.4.6: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ upasampādeyya itthannāmena upajjhāyena.
pli-tv-kd1:28.5.4: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa upasampadā itthannāmena upajjhāyena, so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd1:28.5.10: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa upasampadā itthannāmena upajjhāyena, so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd1:28.6.5: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa upasampadā itthannāmena upajjhāyena, so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd1:28.6.8: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evam etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||6||28||
pli-tv-kd1:29.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu upasampannasamanantarā anācāraṃ ācarati.
pli-tv-kd1:29.1.3: āvuso evarūpaṃ akāsi, n' etaṃ kappatīti.
pli-tv-kd1:29.1.5: n' evāhaṃ āyasmante yāciṃ upasampādetha man ti,
pli-tv-kd1:29.2.2: tena upasampadāpekkhena saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd1:29.2.3: saṃghaṃ bhante upasampadaṃ yācāmi, ullumpatu maṃ bhante saṃgho anukampaṃ upādāya,
pli-tv-kd1:29.3.4: itthannāmo saṃghaṃ upasampadaṃ yācati itthannāmena upajjhāyena.
pli-tv-kd1:29.3.5: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ upasampādeyya itthannāmena upajjhāyena.
pli-tv-kd1:29.4.3: itthannāmo saṃghaṃ upasampadaṃ yācati itthannāmena upajjhāyena.
pli-tv-kd1:29.4.5: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa upasampadā itthannāmena upajjhāyena, so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd1:29.4.10: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evam etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||4||29||
pli-tv-kd1:30.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahe paṇītānaṃ bhattānaṃ bhattapaṭipāṭi adhiṭṭhitā hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:30.1.2: atha kho aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:30.1.3: ime kho samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā sukhasīlā sukhasamācārā, subhojanāni bhuñjitvā nivātesu sayanesu sayanti.
pli-tv-kd1:30.1.4: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ samaṇesu Sakyaputtiyesu pabbajeyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:30.1.5: atha kho so brāhmaṇo bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā pabbajjaṃ yāci,
pli-tv-kd1:30.2.5: nāhaṃ āvuso etaṃkāraṇā pabbajito piṇḍāya carissāmīti,
pli-tv-kd1:30.2.6: sace me dassatha bhuñjissāmi, no ce me dassatha vibbhamissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd1:30.2.7: kiṃ pana tvaṃ āvuso udarassa kāraṇā pabbajito 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:30.3.1: ye te bhikkhū appicchā, te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd1:30.3.2: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye udarassa kāraṇā pabbajissatīti.
pli-tv-kd1:30.3.3: te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:30.3.4: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu udarassa kāraṇā pabbajito 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:30.3.7: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye udarassa kāraṇā pabbajissasi.
pli-tv-kd1:30.3.8: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya.
pli-tv-kd1:30.4.1: anujānāmi bhikkhave upasampādentena cattāro nissaye ācikkhituṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:30.4.2: piṇḍiyālopabhojanaṃ nissāya pabbajjā, tattha te yāvajīvaṃ ussāho karaṇīyo.
pli-tv-kd1:30.4.4: saṃghabhattaṃ uddesabhattaṃ nimantanaṃ salākabhattaṃ pakkhikaṃ uposathikaṃ pāṭipadikaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:30.4.5: paṃsukūlacīvaraṃ nissāya pabbajjā, tattha te yāvajīvaṃ ussāho karaṇīyo.
pli-tv-kd1:30.4.7: khomaṃ kappāsikaṃ koseyyaṃ kambalaṃ sāṇaṃ bhaṅgaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:30.4.8: rukkhamūlasenāsanaṃ nissāya pabbajjā, tattha te yāvajīvaṃ ussāho karaṇīyo.
pli-tv-kd1:30.4.11: pūtimuttabhesajjaṃ nissāya pabbajjā, tattha te yāvajīvaṃ ussāho karaṇīyo.
pli-tv-kd1:30.4.13: sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitan ti. ||4||30|| upajjhāyavattabhāṇavāraṃ niṭṭhitaṃ pañcamaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:31.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro māṇavako bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā pabbajjaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-kd1:31.1.2: tassa bhikkhū paṭigacc' eva nissaye ācikkhiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:31.1.4: sace me bhante pabbajite nissaye ācikkheyyātha abhirameyyaṃ sv āhaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:31.1.8: na bhikkhave paṭigacc' eva nissayā ācikkhitabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:31.1.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave upasampannasamanantarā nissaye ācikkhitun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:31.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū duvaggena pi tivaggena pi gaṇena upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:31.2.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave dasavaggena vā atirekadasavaggena vā gaṇena upasampādetun ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:31.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ekavassāpi duvassāpi saddhivihārikaṃ upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:31.3.2: āyasmāpi Upaseno Vaṅgantaputto ekavasso saddhivihārikaṃ upasampādesi.
pli-tv-kd1:31.3.3: so vassaṃ vuttho duvasso ekavassaṃ saddhivihārikaṃ ādāya yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:31.3.4: āciṇṇaṃ kho pan' etaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ āgantukehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodituṃ. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:31.4.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Upasenaṃ Vaṅgantaputtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:31.4.6: jānantāpi tathāgatā pucchanti, jānantāpi na pucchanti, kālaṃ viditvā pucchanti, kālaṃ viditvā na pucchanti,
pli-tv-kd1:31.4.9: dvīhi ākārehi buddhā bhagavanto bhikkhū paṭipucchanti, dhammaṃ vā desessāma, sāvakānaṃ vā sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpessāmā 'ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd1:31.5.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Upasenaṃ Vaṅgantaputtaṃ etad avoca: kativasso 'si tvaṃ bhikkhū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:31.5.8: ananucchaviyaṃ moghapurisa ananulomikaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:31.5.9: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa aññehi ovadiyo anusāsiyo aññaṃ ovadituṃ anusāsituṃ maññissasi.
pli-tv-kd1:31.5.10: atilahuṃ kho tvaṃ moghapurisa bāhullāya āvatto yad idaṃ gaṇabandhikaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:31.5.11: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:31.5.16: anujānāmi bhikkhave dasavassena vā atirekadasavassena vā upasampādetun ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd1:31.6.8: aññataro pi aññatitthiyapubbo upajjhāyena sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno upajjhāyassa vādaṃ āropetvā taṃ yeva titthāyatanaṃ saṃkami. ||6||
pli-tv-kd1:31.7.1: ye te bhikkhū appicchā, te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd1:31.7.2: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū dasavass' amhā dasavass' amhā 'ti bālā avyattā upasampādessanti,
pli-tv-kd1:31.7.4: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:31.8.2: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā dasavass' amhā dasavass' amhā 'ti bālā avyattā upasampādessanti,
pli-tv-kd1:31.8.4: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --la--,
pli-tv-kd1:31.8.9: anujānāmi bhikkhave vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena dasavassena vā atirekadasavassena vā upasampādetun ti. ||8||31||
pli-tv-kd1:32.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū upajjhāyesu pakkantesu pi vibbhamantesu pi kālaṃkatesu pi pakkhasaṃkantesu pi anācariyakā anovadiyamānā ananusāsiyamānā
pli-tv-kd1:32.1.15: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:32.1.17: ācariyo bhikkhave antevāsikamhi puttacittaṃ upaṭṭhāpessati, antevāsiko ācariyamhi pitucittaṃ upaṭṭhāpessati.
pli-tv-kd1:32.1.18: evaṃ te aññamaññaṃ sagāravā sappatissā sabhāgavuttino viharantā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissanti.
pli-tv-kd1:32.1.19: anujānāmi bhikkhave dasa vassāni nissāya vatthuṃ, dasavassena nissayaṃ dātuṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:32.2.1: evañ ca pana bhikkhave ācariyo gahetabbo:
pli-tv-kd1:32.2.2: ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd1:32.2.3: ācariyo me bhante hohi, āyasmato nissāya vacchāmi,
pli-tv-kd1:32.2.4: ācariyo me bhante hohi, āyasmato nissāya vacchāmi,
pli-tv-kd1:32.2.5: ācariyo me bhante hohi, āyasmato nissāya vacchāmīti.
pli-tv-kd1:32.2.6: sāhū 'ti vā, lahū 'ti vā, opāyikan ti vā, paṭirūpan ti vā, pāsādikena sampādehīti vā kāyena viññāpeti, vācāya viññāpeti, kāyena vācāya viññāpeti, gahito hoti ācariyo,
pli-tv-kd1:32.2.7: na kāyena viññāpeti, na vācāya viññāpeti, na kāyena vācāya viññāpeti, na gahito hoti ācariyo. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:32.3.3.1: kālass' eva uṭṭhāya upāhanā omuñcitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā dantakaṭṭhaṃ dātabbaṃ, mukhodakaṃ dātabbaṃ, āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:32.3.4: sace yāgu hoti, bhājanaṃ dhovitvā yāgu upanāmetabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:32.3.5: yāguṃ pītassa udakaṃ datvā bhājanaṃ paṭiggahetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena dhovitvā paṭisāmetabbaṃ . . . (=
pli-tv-kd1:32.3.125: sace ācariyo gilāno hoti, yāvajīvaṃ upaṭṭhātabbo, vuṭṭhānassa āgametabban ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:33.1.3: ācariyena bhikkhave antevāsiko saṃgahetabbo anuggahetabbo uddesena paripucchāya ovādena anusāsaniyā.
pli-tv-kd1:33.1.4: sace ācariyassa patto hoti, antevāsikassa patto na hoti, ācariyena antevāsikassa patto dātabbo ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:33.1.5: kin ti nu kho antevāsikassa patto uppajjiyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:33.1.6: sace ācariyassa cīvaraṃ . . . (= I.26.1-11; instead of upajjhāyo,
pli-tv-kd1:33.1.109: sace antevāsiko gilāno hoti, yāvajīvaṃ upaṭṭhātabbo, vuṭṭhānassa āgametabban ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:34.1.1: tena kho pana samayena antevāsikā ācariyesu na
pli-tv-kd1:35.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū dasavass' amhā dasavass' amhā 'ti bālā avyattā nissayaṃ denti,
pli-tv-kd1:35.1.6: ye te bhikkhū appicchā, te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd1:35.1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū dasavass' amhā dasavass' amhā 'ti bālā avyattā nissayaṃ dassanti,
pli-tv-kd1:35.2.1: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:35.2.9: na bhikkhave bālena avyattena nissayo dātabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:35.2.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena dasavassena vā atirekadasavassena vā nissayaṃ dātun ti. ||2||35||
pli-tv-kd1:36.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ācariyupajjhāyesu pa- kkantesu pi vibbhamantesu pi kālaṃkatesu pi pakkhasaṃkantesu pi nissayapaṭippassaddhiyo na jānanti.
pli-tv-kd1:36.1.4: upajjhāyo pakkanto vā hoti vibbhamanto vā kālaṃkato vā pakkhasaṃkanto vā, āṇatti yeva pañcamī.
pli-tv-kd1:36.1.5: imā kho bhikkhave pañca nissayapaṭippassaddhiyo upajjhāyamhā.
pli-tv-kd1:36.1.7: ācariyo pakkanto vā hoti vibbhamanto vā kālaṃkato vā pakkhasaṃkanto vā, āṇatti yeva pañcamī, upajjhāyena vā samodhānaṃ gato hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:36.1.8: imā kho bhikkhave cha nissayapaṭippassaddhiyo ācariyamhā. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:36.2.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na upasampādetabbaṃ, na nissayo dātabbo, na sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd1:36.2.2: na asekhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, na asekhena samādhikkhandhena samannāgato hoti, na asekhena paññākkhandhena samannāgato hoti, na asekhena vimuttikkhandhena samannāgato hoti, na asekhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena samannāgato hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:36.2.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na upasampādetabbaṃ, na nissayo dātabbo, na sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:36.3.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā upasampādetabbaṃ, nissayo dātabbo, sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd1:36.3.2: asekhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, . . . asekhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena samannāgato hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:36.3.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā upasampādetabbaṃ, nissayo dātabbo, sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:36.4.1: aparehi pi bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na upasampādetabbaṃ, na nissayo dātabbo, na sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd1:36.4.2: attanā na asekhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, na paraṃ asekhe sīlakkhandhe samādapetā, . . .
pli-tv-kd1:36.4.6: vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, na paraṃ asekhe vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhe samādapetā.
pli-tv-kd1:36.4.7: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na upasampādetabbaṃ, na nissayo dātabbo, na sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo. ||4||
pli-tv-kd1:36.5.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā upasampādetabbaṃ, nissayo dātabbo, sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd1:36.5.2: attanā asekhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, paraṃ asekhe sīlakkhandhe samādapetā, . . .
pli-tv-kd1:36.5.6: vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, paraṃ asekhe vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhe samādapetā.
pli-tv-kd1:36.5.7: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā upasampādetabbaṃ, nissayo dātabbo, sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo. ||5||
pli-tv-kd1:36.6.1: aparehi pi bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na upasampādetabbaṃ, na nissayo dātabbo, na sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd1:36.6.2: assaddho hoti, ahiriko hoti, anottappī hoti, kusīto hoti, muṭṭhassati hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:36.6.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na upasampādetabbaṃ, na nissayo dātabbo, na sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo. ||6||
pli-tv-kd1:36.7.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā upasampādetabbaṃ, nissayo dātabbo, sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo:
