pli-tv-kd1:38.1.1: tena kho pana samayena yo so aññatitthiyapubbo upajjhāyena sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno upajjhāyassa vādaṃ āropetvā taṃ yeva titthāyatanaṃ saṃkami,
pli-tv-kd1:38.1.2: so puna paccāgantvā bhikkhū upasampadaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-kd1:38.1.4: yo so bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo upajjhāyena sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno upajjhāyassa vādaṃ āropetvā taṃ yeva titthāyatanaṃ saṃkanto, so āgato na upasampādetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:38.1.5: yo bhikkhave añño pi aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ, ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ, tassa cattāro māse parivāso dātabbo. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:38.2.2: paṭhamaṃ kesamassuṃ ohārāpetvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādāpetvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ kārāpetvā bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vandāpetvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīdāpetvā añjaliṃ paggaṇhāpetvā evaṃ vadehīti vattabbo:
pli-tv-kd1:38.2.6: dutiyam pi . . . tatiyam pi buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi,
pli-tv-kd1:38.3.1: tena kho bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbena saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd1:38.3.2: ahaṃ bhante itthannāmo aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhāmi upasampadaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:38.3.3: so 'haṃ bhante saṃghaṃ cattāro māse parivāsaṃ yācāmīti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.3.8: ayaṃ itthannāmo aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:38.3.9: so saṃghaṃ cattāro māse parivāsaṃ yācati.
pli-tv-kd1:38.3.10: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmassa aññatitthiyapubbassa cattāro māse parivāsaṃ dadeyya.
pli-tv-kd1:38.4.2: ayaṃ itthannāmo aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:38.4.3: so saṃghaṃ cattāro māse parivāsaṃ yācati.
pli-tv-kd1:38.4.4: saṃgho itthannāmassa aññatitthiyapubbassa cattāro māse parivāsaṃ deti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.4.5: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa aññatitthiyapubbassa cattāro māse parivāsassa dānaṃ, so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd1:38.4.7: dinno saṃghena itthannāmassa aññatitthiyapubbassa cattāro māse parivāso.
pli-tv-kd1:38.4.8: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evam etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd1:38.5.1: evaṃ kho bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo ārādhako hoti, evaṃ anārādhako.
pli-tv-kd1:38.5.2: kathañ ca bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo anārādhako hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.5.3: idha bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo atikālena gāmaṃ pavisati, atidivā paṭikkamati.
pli-tv-kd1:38.5.4: evam pi bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo anārādhako hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.5.5: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo vesiyāgocaro vā hoti, vidhavāgocaro vā hoti, thullakumārikagocaro vā hoti, paṇḍakagocaro vā hoti, bhikkhunīgocaro vā hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.5.6: evam pi bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo anārādhako hoti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd1:38.6.1: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ uccāvacāni karaṇīyāni, tattha na dakkho hoti, na analaso, na tatrupāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato, na alaṃ kātuṃ, na alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:38.6.2: evam pi bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo anārādhako hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.6.3: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo na tibbacchando hoti uddese paripucchāya adhisīle adhicitte adhipaññāya.
pli-tv-kd1:38.6.4: evam pi bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo anārādhako hoti. ||6||
pli-tv-kd1:38.7.1: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo yassa titthāyatanā saṃkanto hoti, tassa satthuno tassa diṭṭhiyā tassa khantiyā tassa ruciyā tassa ādāyassa avaṇṇe bhaññamāne kupito hoti anattamano anabhiraddho, buddhassa vā dhammassa vā saṃghassa vā avaṇṇe bhaññamāne attamano hoti udaggo abhiraddho,
pli-tv-kd1:38.7.2: yassa vā pana titthāyatanā saṃkanto hoti, tassa satthuno tassa diṭṭhiyā tassa khantiyā tassa ruciyā tassa ādāyassa vaṇṇe bhaññamāne attamano hoti udaggo abhiraddho, buddhassa vā dhammassa vā saṃghassa vā vaṇṇe bhaññamāne kupito hoti anattamano anabhiraddho,
pli-tv-kd1:38.7.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo anārādhako hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:38.7.5: evaṃ anārādhako kho bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo āgato na upasampādetabbo. ||7||
pli-tv-kd1:38.8.1: kathañ ca bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo ārādhako hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.8.2: idha bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo nātikālena gāmaṃ pavisati, nātidivā paṭikkamati.
pli-tv-kd1:38.8.3: evam pi bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo ārādhako hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.8.4: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo na vesiyāgocaro hoti, na vidhavāgocaro hoti, na thullakumārikagocaro hoti, na paṇḍakagocaro hoti, na bhikkhunīgocaro hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.8.5: evam pi bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo ārādhako hoti. ||8||
pli-tv-kd1:38.9.1: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ uccāvacāni karaṇīyāni, tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatrupāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato, alaṃ kātuṃ, alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:38.9.2: evam pi bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo ārādhako hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.9.3: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo tibbacchando hoti uddese paripucchāya adhisīle adhicitte adhipaññāya.
pli-tv-kd1:38.9.4: evam pi bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo ārādhako hoti. ||9||
pli-tv-kd1:38.10.1: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo yassa titthāyatanā saṃkanto hoti, tassa satthuno tassa diṭṭhiyā tassa khantiyā tassa ruciyā tassa ādāyassa avaṇṇe bhaññamāne attamano hoti udaggo abhiraddho, buddhassa vā dhammassa vā saṃghassa vā avaṇṇe bhaññamāne kupito hoti anattamano anabhiraddho,
pli-tv-kd1:38.10.2: yassa vā pana titthāyatanā saṃkanto hoti, tassa satthuno tassa diṭṭhiyā tassa khantiyā tassa ruciyā tassa ādāyassa vaṇṇe bhaññamāne kupito hoti anattamano anabhiraddho, buddhassa vā dhammassa vā saṃghassa vā vaṇṇe bhaññamāne attamano hoti udaggo abhiraddho.
pli-tv-kd1:38.10.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo ārādhako hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.10.5: evaṃ ārādhako kho bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo āgato upasampādetabbo. ||10||
pli-tv-kd1:38.11.1: sace bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo naggo āgacchati, upajjhāyamūlakaṃ cīvaraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:38.11.2: sace acchinnakeso āgacchati, saṃgho apaloketabbo bhaṇḍukammāya.
pli-tv-kd1:38.11.3: ye te bhikkhave aggikā jaṭilakā, te āgatā upasampādetabbā, na tesaṃ parivāso dātabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:38.11.6: sace bhikkhave jātiyā Sākiyo aññatitthiyapubbo āgacchati, so āgato upasampādetabbo, na tassa parivāso dātabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:38.11.7: imāhaṃ bhikkhave ñātīnaṃ āveṇiyaṃ parihāraṃ dammīti. ||11||
pli-tv-kd1:39.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Magadhesu pañca ābādhā ussannā honti
pli-tv-kd1:39.1.3: manussā pañcahi ābādhehi phuṭṭhā Jīvakaṃ Komārabhaccaṃ upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadanti:
pli-tv-kd1:39.1.6: rājā ca me Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro upaṭṭhātabbo itthāgārañ ca buddhapamukho ca bhikkhusaṃgho,
pli-tv-kd1:39.1.8: sabbaṃ sāpateyyañ ca te ācariya hotu,
pli-tv-kd1:39.2.1: ahaṃ kho 'yyo bahukicco bahukaraṇīyo, rājā ca me Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro upaṭṭhātabbo itthāgārañ ca buddhapamukho ca bhikkhusaṃgho,
pli-tv-kd1:39.2.3: atha kho tesaṃ manussānaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:39.2.4: ime kho samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā sukhasīlā sukhasamācārā subhojanāni bhuñjitvā nivātesu sayanesu sayanti.
pli-tv-kd1:39.2.5: yaṃ nūna mayaṃ samaṇesu Sakyaputtiyesu pabbajeyyāma,
pli-tv-kd1:39.2.6: tattha bhikkhū c' eva upaṭṭhahissanti Jīvako ca Komārabhacco tikicchissatīti.
pli-tv-kd1:39.2.7: atha kho te manussā bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā pabbajjaṃ yāciṃsu,
pli-tv-kd1:39.2.9: te bhikkhū c' eva upaṭṭhahiṃsu Jīvako ca Komārabhacco tikicchi. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:39.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bahū gilāne bhikkhū upaṭṭhahantā yācanabahulā viññattibahulā viharanti
pli-tv-kd1:39.3.2: gilānabhattaṃ detha, gilānupaṭṭhākabhattaṃ detha, gilānabhesajjaṃ dethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:39.3.3: Jīvako pi Komārabhacco bahū gilāne bhikkhū tikicchanto aññataraṃ rājakiccaṃ parihāpesi. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:39.4.1: aññataro puriso pañcahi ābādhehi phuṭṭho Jīvakaṃ Komārabhaccaṃ upasaṃkamitvā etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:39.4.3: ahaṃ kho 'yyo bahukicco bahukaraṇīyo, rājā ca me Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro upaṭṭhātabbo itthāgārañ ca buddhapamukho ca bhikkhusaṃgho,
pli-tv-kd1:39.4.5: sabbaṃ sāpateyyañ ca te ācariya hotu, ahañ ca te dāso,
pli-tv-kd1:39.4.7: ahaṃ kho 'yyo bahukicco bahukaraṇīyo, rājā ca me Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro upaṭṭhātabbo itthāgārañ ca buddhapamukho ca bhikkhusaṃgho, nāhaṃ sakkomi tikicchitun ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd1:39.5.1: atha kho tassa purisassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:39.5.2: ime kho samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā sukhasīlā sukhasamācārā subhojanāni bhuñjitvā nivātesu sayanesu sayanti.
pli-tv-kd1:39.5.4: tattha bhikkhū c' eva upaṭṭhahissanti, Jīvako ca Komārabhacco tikicchissati,
pli-tv-kd1:39.5.6: atha kho so puriso bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā pabbajjaṃ yāci,
pli-tv-kd1:39.5.8: taṃ bhikkhū c' eva upaṭṭhahiṃsu Jīvako ca Komārabhacco tikicchi,
pli-tv-kd1:39.5.10: addasa kho Jīvako Komārabhacco taṃ purisaṃ vibbhamantaṃ, disvāna taṃ purisaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:39.5.11: nanu tvaṃ ayyo bhikkhūsu pabbajito ahosīti.
pli-tv-kd1:39.5.13: kissa pana tvaṃ ayyo evarūpaṃ akāsīti.
pli-tv-kd1:39.5.14: atha kho so puriso Jīvakassa Komārabhaccassa etam atthaṃ ārocesi. ||5||
pli-tv-kd1:39.6.2: kathaṃ hi nāma bhaddantā pañcahi ābādhehi phuṭṭhaṃ pabbājessantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:39.6.3: atha kho Jīvako Komārabhacco yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:39.6.4: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Jīvako Komārabhacco bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:39.6.5: sādhu bhante ayyā pañcahi ābādhehi phuṭṭhaṃ na pabbājeyyun ti. ||6||
pli-tv-kd1:39.7.1: atha kho bhagavā Jīvakaṃ Komārabhaccaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd1:39.7.2: atha kho Jīvako Komārabhacco bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:39.7.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:39.7.4: na bhikkhave pañcahi ābādhehi phuṭṭho pabbājetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:40.1.1: tena kho pana samayena rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa paccanto kupito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:40.1.2: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro senānāyake mahāmatte āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd1:40.1.4: evaṃ devā 'ti kho senānāyakā mahāmattā rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa paccassosuṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:40.2.1: atha kho abhiññātānaṃ -abhiññātānaṃ yodhānaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:40.2.2: mayaṃ kho yuddhābhinandino gacchantā pāpañ ca karoma bahuñ ca apuññaṃ pasavāma.
pli-tv-kd1:40.2.3: kena nu kho mayaṃ upāyena pāpā ca virameyyāma kalyāṇañ ca kareyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:40.2.4: atha kho tesaṃ yodhānaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:40.2.5: ime kho samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā dhammacārino samacārino brahmacārino saccavādino sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā.
pli-tv-kd1:40.2.6: sace kho mayaṃ samaṇesu Sakyaputtiyesu pabbajeyyāma, evaṃ mayaṃ pāpā ca virameyyāma kalyāṇañ ca kareyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:40.2.7: atha kho te yodhā bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā pabbajjaṃ yāciṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:40.3.2: kiṃ nu kho bhaṇe itthannāmo ca itthannāmo ca yodhā na dissantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:40.3.3: itthannāmo ca itthannāmo ca sāmi yodhā bhikkhūsu pabbajitā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:40.3.5: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā rājabhaṭaṃ pabbājessantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:40.3.6: senānāyakā mahāmattā rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:40.3.7: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro vohārike mahāmatte pucchi:
pli-tv-kd1:40.3.8: yo bhaṇe rājabhaṭaṃ pabbājeti, kiṃ so pasavatīti.
pli-tv-kd1:40.3.9: upajjhāyassa deva sīsaṃ chedetabbaṃ, anussāvakassa jivhā uddharitabbā, gaṇassa upaḍḍhaphāsukā bhañjitabbā 'ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:40.4.1: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:40.4.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:40.4.5: sādhu bhante ayyā rājabhaṭaṃ na pabbājeyyun ti.
pli-tv-kd1:40.4.6: atha kho bhagavā rājānaṃ Māgadhaṃ Seniyaṃ Bimbisāraṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd1:40.4.7: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:40.4.8: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:41.1.1: tena kho pana samayena coro aṅgulimālo bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:41.1.2: manussā passitvā ubbijjanti pi uttasanti pi palāyanti pi aññena pi gacchanti aññena pi mukhaṃ karonti dvāram pi thakenti.
pli-tv-kd1:41.1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā dhajabaddhaṃ coraṃ pabbājessantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:41.1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:41.1.6: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:42.1.1: tena kho pana samayena raññā Māgadhena Seniyena Bimbisārena anuññātaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd1:42.1.2: ye samaṇesu Sakyaputtiyesu pabbajanti, na te labbhā kiñci kātuṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:42.1.3: svākkhāto dhammo, carantu brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:42.1.4: tena kho pana samayena aññataro puriso corikaṃ katvā kārāya baddho hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:42.1.5: so kāraṃ bhinditvā palāyitvā bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:42.2.7: ye samaṇesu Sakyaputtiyesu pabbajanti, na te labbhā kiñci kātuṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:42.2.8: svākkhāto dhammo, carantu brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:42.2.10: abhayūvarā ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā, na yime labbhā kiñci kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:42.2.11: kathaṃ hi nāma kārabhedakaṃ coraṃ pabbājessantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:43.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro puriso corikaṃ katvā palāyitvā bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:43.1.2: so ca rañño antepure likhito hoti
pli-tv-kd1:43.1.11: abhayūvarā ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā, na yime labbhā kiñci kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:43.1.12: kathaṃ hi nāma likhitakaṃ coraṃ pabbājessantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:44.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro puriso kasāhato katadaṇḍakammo bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:44.1.3: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā kasāhataṃ katadaṇḍakammaṃ pabbājessantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:45.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro puriso lakkhaṇāhato katadaṇḍakammo bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:45.1.3: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā lakkhaṇāhataṃ katadaṇḍakammaṃ pabbājessantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:46.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro puriso iṇāyiko palāyitvā bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:46.1.8: ye samaṇesu Sakyaputtiyesu pabbajanti, na te labbhā kiñci kātuṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:46.1.9: svākkhāto dhammo, carantu brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:47.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro dāso palāyitvā bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:47.1.8: abhayūvarā ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā, na yime labbhā kiñci kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:48.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro kammārabhaṇḍu mātāpitūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍitvā ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:48.1.2: atha kho tassa kammārabhaṇḍussa mātāpitaro taṃ kammārabhaṇḍuṃ vicinantā ārāmam gantvā bhikkhū pucchiṃsu:
pli-tv-kd1:48.2.1: atha kho tassa kammārabhaṇḍussa mātāpitaro taṃ kammārabhaṇḍuṃ vicinantā bhikkhūsu pabbajitaṃ disvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd1:48.2.2: alajjino ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā dussīlā musāvādino,
pli-tv-kd1:48.2.3: jānaṃ yeva āhaṃsu: na jānāmā 'ti, passaṃ yeva āhaṃsu: na passāmā 'ti,
pli-tv-kd1:48.2.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa kammārabhaṇḍussa mātāpitunnaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:48.2.6: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:49.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahe sattarasavaggiyā dārakā sahāyakā honti,
pli-tv-kd1:49.1.3: atha kho Upālissa mātāpitunnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:49.1.4: kena nu kho upāyena Upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañ ca jīveyya na ca kilameyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.1.5: atha kho Upālissa mātāpitunnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:49.1.6: sace kho Upāli lekhaṃ sikkheyya, evaṃ kho Upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañ ca jīveyya na ca kilameyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.1.7: atha kho Upālissa mātāpitunnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:49.1.8: sace kho Upāli lekhaṃ sikkhissati, aṅguliyo dukkhā bhavissanti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.1.9: sace kho Upāli gaṇanaṃ sikkheyya, evaṃ kho Upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañ ca jīveyya na ca kilameyyā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:49.1.10: atha kho Upālissa mātāpitunnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:49.2.1: sace kho Upāli gaṇanaṃ sikkhissati, urassa dukkho bhavissati.
pli-tv-kd1:49.2.2: sace kho Upāli rūpaṃ sikkheyya, evaṃ kho Upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañ ca jīveyya na ca kilameyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.2.3: atha kho Upālissa mātāpitunnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:49.2.4: sace kho Upāli rūpaṃ sikkhissati, akkhīni dukkhā bhavissanti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.2.5: ime kho samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā sukhasīlā sukhasamācārā subhojanāni bhuñjitvā nivātesu sayanesu sayanti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.2.6: sace kho Upāli samaṇesu Sakyaputtiyesu pabbajeyya, evaṃ kho Upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañ ca jīveyya na ca kilameyyā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:49.3.1: assosi kho Upāli dārako mātāpitunnaṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:49.3.2: atha kho Upāli dārako yena te dārakā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā te dārake etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:49.3.3: etha mayaṃ ayyo samaṇesu Sakyaputtiyesu pabbajissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.3.4: sace kho tvaṃ ayyo pabbajissasi, evaṃ mayam pi pabbajissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.3.5: atha kho te dārakā ekamekassa mātāpitaro upasaṃkamitvā etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:49.3.8: sabbe p' ime dārakā samānacchandā kalyāṇādhippāyā 'ti
pli-tv-kd1:49.4.2: yāguṃ detha, bhattaṃ detha, khādaniyaṃ dethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.4.5: sace yāgu bhavissati, pivissatha, sace bhattaṃ bhavissati, bhuñjissatha, sace khādaniyaṃ bhavissati, khādissatha,
pli-tv-kd1:49.4.6: no ce bhavissati yāgu vā bhattaṃ vā khādaniyaṃ vā, piṇḍāya caritvā bhuñjissathā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.4.7: evam pi kho te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi vuccamānā rodant' eva: yāguṃ detha, bhattaṃ detha, khādaniyaṃ dethā 'ti,
pli-tv-kd1:49.5.1: assosi kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya dārakasaddaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:49.5.3: kiṃ nu kho so Ānanda dārakassa saddo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.5.4: atha kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:49.5.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū jānaṃ ūnavīsativassaṃ puggalaṃ upasampādentīti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.5.8: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā jānaṃ ūnavīsativassaṃ puggalaṃ upasampādessanti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd1:49.6.1: ūnavīsativasso bhikkhave puggalo akkhamo hoti sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ anadhivāsakajātiko hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.6.2: vīsativasso kho bhikkhave puggalo khamo hoti sītassa uṇhassa . . . pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsakajātiko hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.6.3: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya.
pli-tv-kd1:49.6.6: na bhikkhave jānaṃ ūnavīsativasso puggalo upasampādetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:50.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataraṃ kulaṃ ahivātakarogena kālaṃkataṃ hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:50.1.3: te bhikkhūsu pabbajitvā ekato 'va piṇḍāya caranti.
pli-tv-kd1:50.1.4: atha kho so dārako pituno bhikkhāya dinnāya upadhāvitvā etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:50.1.10: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:50.1.11: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:51.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Ānandassa upaṭṭhākakulaṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ ahivātakarogena kālaṃkataṃ hoti, dve ca dārakā sesā honti,
pli-tv-kd1:51.1.2: te porāṇakena āciṇṇakappena bhikkhū passitvā upadhāvanti,
pli-tv-kd1:51.1.5: atha kho āyasmato Ānandassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:51.1.9: kena nu kho upāyena ime dārakā na vinasseyyun ti.
pli-tv-kd1:51.1.10: atha kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:51.1.11: ussahanti pana te Ānanda dārakā kāke uṭṭepetun ti.
pli-tv-kd1:51.1.13: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:51.1.14: anujānami bhikkhave ūnapannarasavassaṃ dārakaṃ kākuṭṭepakaṃ pabbājetun ti. ||1||51||
pli-tv-kd1:52.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Upanandassa Sakyaputtassa dve sāmaṇerā honti
pli-tv-kd1:52.1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma sāmaṇerā evarūpaṃ anācāraṃ ācarissantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:52.1.7: na bhikkhave ekena dve sāmaṇerā upaṭṭhāpetabbā.
pli-tv-kd1:53.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tatth' eva Rājagahe vassaṃ vasi, tattha hemantaṃ, tattha gimhaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:53.1.3: āhundarikā samaṇānaṃ Sakyaputtiyānaṃ disā andhakārā, na imesaṃ disā pakkhāyantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:53.1.4: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:53.1.5: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:53.2.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:53.2.2: gacchānanda apāpuraṇaṃ ādāya anupariveṇiyaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ārocehi:
pli-tv-kd1:53.2.3: icchat' āvuso bhagavā Dakkhiṇāgiriṃ cārikaṃ pakkamituṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:53.2.5: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā apāpuraṇaṃ ādāya anupariveṇiyaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ārocesi:
pli-tv-kd1:53.2.6: icchat' āvuso bhagavā Dakkhiṇāgiriṃ cārikaṃ pakkamituṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:53.3.2: bhagavatā āvuso Ānanda paññattaṃ dasa vassāni nissāya vatthuṃ, dasavassena nissayaṃ dātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:53.3.3: tattha ca no gantabbaṃ bhavissati, nissayo ca gahetabbo bhavissati, ittaro ca vāso bhavissati, puna ca paccāgantabbaṃ bhavissati, puna ca nissayo gahetabbo bhavissati.
pli-tv-kd1:53.3.4: sace amhākaṃ ācariyupajjhāyā gamissanti, mayam pi gamissāma,
pli-tv-kd1:53.3.5: no ce amhākaṃ ācariyupajjhāyā gamissanti, mayam pi na gamissāma.
pli-tv-kd1:53.4.1: atha kho bhagavā ogaṇena bhikkhusaṃghena Dakkhiṇāgiriṃ cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:53.4.2.1: atha kho bhagavā Dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā punad eva Rājagahaṃ paccāgacchi.
pli-tv-kd1:53.4.3: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:53.4.4: kiṃ nu kho Ānanda tathāgato ogaṇena bhikkhusaṃghena Dakkhiṇāgiriṃ cārikaṃ pakkanto 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:53.4.5: atha kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:53.4.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:53.4.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena pañca vassāni nissāya vatthuṃ, avyattena yāvajīvaṃ. ||4||
pli-tv-kd1:53.5.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.5.2: na asekhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti . . . (= I.36,2) . . .
pli-tv-kd1:53.5.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:53.5.4: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.5.9: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ. ||5||
pli-tv-kd1:53.6.1: aparehi pi bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.6.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:53.6.4: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.9.5: āpattiṃ . . . (= I.36,15) . . . imehi kho . . . anissitena vatthabbaṃ. ||8|| aparehi pi . . . na anissitena vatthabbaṃ: āpattiṃ . . . (= I.36,16) . . . ūnapañcavasso hoti. imehi kho . . . na anissitena vatthabbaṃ. pañcahi . . . anissitena vatthabbaṃ: āpattiṃ . . . (= I.36,17) . . . pañcavasso vā hoti atirekapañcavasso vā.
pli-tv-kd1:53.10.1: chahi . . . na anissitena vatthabbaṃ: na asekhena . . . (= I.37,1) . . . ūnapañcavasso hoti. imehi kho bhikkhave chah' aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:53.10.5: I.37,2) . . . pañcavasso vā hoti atirekapañcavasso vā.
pli-tv-kd1:53.11.1: aparehi pi bhikkhave chah' aṅgehi . . . na anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.11.5: saddho . . . (= I.37,6) . . . pañcavasso vā hoti atirekapañcavasso vā.
pli-tv-kd1:53.12.5: na adhisīle . . . (= I.37,8) . . . pañcavasso vā hoti atirekapañcavasso vā.
pli-tv-kd1:53.13.5: āpattiṃ . . . (= I.37,14) . . . pañcavasso vā hoti atirekapañcavasso vā.
pli-tv-kd1:53.13.6: imehi kho . . . anissitena vatthabban ti. ||13||53|| abhayūvarabhāṇavāraṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:54.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Rājagahe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Kapilavatthu tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:54.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Kapilavatthu tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd1:54.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme.
pli-tv-kd1:54.1.4: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Suddhodanassa Sakkassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:54.1.5: atha kho Rāhulamātā devī Rāhulakumāraṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:54.2.1: atha kho Rāhulo kumāro yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato purato aṭṭhāsi
pli-tv-kd1:54.2.4: atha kho Rāhulo kumāro bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito -piṭṭhito anubandhi
pli-tv-kd1:54.2.7: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:54.2.8: tena hi tvaṃ Sāriputta Rāhulakumāraṃ pabbājehīti.
pli-tv-kd1:54.3.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:54.3.4: paṭhamaṃ kesamassuṃ ohārāpetvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādāpetvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ kārāpetvā bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vandāpetvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīdāpetvā añjaliṃ paggaṇhāpetvā evaṃ vadehīti vattabbo:
pli-tv-kd1:54.3.8: dutiyam pi . . . tatiyam pi buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi,
pli-tv-kd1:54.3.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave imehi tīhi saraṇagamanehi sāmaṇerapabbajjan ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:54.4.1: atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto Rāhulakumāraṃ pabbājesi.
pli-tv-kd1:54.4.2: atha kho Suddhodano Sakko yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:54.4.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Suddhodano Sakko bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:54.4.6: yañ ca bhante kappati yañ ca anavajjan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:54.5.1: bhagavati me bhante pabbajite anappakaṃ dukkhaṃ ahosi, tathā Nande, adhimattaṃ Rāhule.
pli-tv-kd1:54.5.2: puttapemaṃ bhante chaviṃ chindati, chaviṃ chetvā cammaṃ chindati, cammaṃ chetvā maṃsaṃ chindati, maṃsaṃ chetvā nhāruṃ chindati, nhāruṃ chetvā aṭṭhiṃ chindati, aṭṭhiṃ chetvā aṭṭhimiñjaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati.
pli-tv-kd1:54.5.3: sādhu bhante ayyā ananuññātaṃ mātāpitūhi puttaṃ na pabbājeyyun ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd1:54.6.1: atha kho bhagavā Suddhodanaṃ Sakkaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd1:54.6.2: atha kho Suddhodano Sakko bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:54.6.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:54.6.4: na bhikkhave ananuññāto mātāpitūhi putto pabbājetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:55.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Kapilavatthusmiṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:55.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Sāvatthi tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd1:55.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd1:55.1.4: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Sāriputtassa upaṭṭhākakulaṃ āyasmato Sāriputtassa santike dārakaṃ pāhesi
pli-tv-kd1:55.1.6: atha kho āyasmato Sāriputtassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:55.1.10: kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd1:55.1.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena ekena dve sāmaṇere upaṭṭhāpetuṃ, yāvatake vā pana ussahati ovadituṃ anusāsituṃ, tāvatake upaṭṭhāpetun ti. ||1||55||
pli-tv-kd1:56.1.2: kati nu kho amhākaṃ sikkhāpadāni, kattha ca amhehi sikkhitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd1:56.1.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave sāmaṇerānaṃ dasa sikkhāpadāni, tesu ca sāmaṇerehi sikkhituṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:56.1.15: anujānāmi bhikkhave sāmaṇerānaṃ imāni dasa sikkhāpadāni, imesu ca sāmaṇerehi sikkhitun ti. ||1||56||
pli-tv-kd1:57.1.1: tena kho pana samayena sāmaṇerā bhikkhūsu agāravā appatissā asabhāgavuttino viharanti.
pli-tv-kd1:57.1.3: kathaṃ hi nāma sāmaṇerā bhikkhūsu agāravā appatissā asabhāgavuttino viharissantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:57.1.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgatassa sāmaṇerassa daṇḍakammaṃ kātuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:57.1.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave imehi pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgatassa sāmaṇerassa daṇḍakammaṃ kātun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:57.2.2: kiṃ nu kho daṇḍakammaṃ kātabban ti.
pli-tv-kd1:57.2.5: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū sāmaṇerānaṃ sabbaṃ saṃghārāmaṃ āvaraṇaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd1:57.2.6: sāmaṇerā ārāmaṃ pavisituṃ alabhamānā pakkamanti pi vibbhamanti pi titthiyesu pi saṃkamanti.
pli-tv-kd1:57.2.8: na bhikkhave sabbo saṃghārāmo āvaraṇaṃ kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:57.2.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave yattha vā vasati, yattha vā paṭikkamati, tattha āvaraṇaṃ kātun ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:57.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū sāmaṇerānaṃ mukhadvārakaṃ āhāraṃ āvaraṇaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd1:57.3.2: manussā yāgupānam pi saṃghabhattam pi karontā sāmaṇere evaṃ vadanti:
pli-tv-kd1:57.3.9: kathaṃ hi nāma bhaddantā sāmaṇerānaṃ mukhadvārakaṃ āhāraṃ āvaraṇaṃ karissantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:57.3.11: na bhikkhave mukhadvārako āhāro āvāraṇaṃ kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:58.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū upajjhāye anāpucchā sāmaṇerānaṃ āvaraṇaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd1:58.1.3: kathaṃ nu kho amhākaṃ sāmaṇerā na dissantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:58.1.5: chabbaggiyehi āvuso bhikkhūhi āvaraṇaṃ katan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:58.1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū amhe anāpucchā amhākaṃ sāmaṇerānaṃ āvaraṇaṃ karissantīti.
pli-tv-kd1:58.1.9: na bhikkhave upajjhāye anāpucchā āvaraṇaṃ kātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:59.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbagiyā bhikkhū therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sāmaṇere apalāḷenti.
pli-tv-kd1:59.1.2: therā sāmaṃ dantakaṭṭham pi mukhodakam pi gaṇhantā kilamanti.
pli-tv-kd1:60.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Upanandassa Sakyaputtassa Kaṇḍako nāma sāmaṇero Kaṇḍakaṃ nāma bhikkhuniṃ dūsesi.
pli-tv-kd1:60.1.3: kathaṃ hi nāma sāmaṇero evarūpaṃ anācāraṃ ācarissatīti.
pli-tv-kd1:60.1.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave dasah' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ sāmaṇeraṃ nāsetuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:60.1.16: anujānāmi bhikkhave imehi dasah' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ sāmaṇeraṃ nāsetun ti. ||1||60||
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro paṇḍako bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.2: so dahare-dahare bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.5: nassa paṇḍaka, vinassa paṇḍaka, ko tayā attho 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.6: so bhikkhūhi apasādito mahante-mahante moligalle sāmaṇere upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.9: nassa paṇḍaka, vinassa paṇḍaka, ko tayā attho 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.10: so sāmaṇerehi apasādito hatthibhaṇḍe assabhaṇḍe upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.15: ye pi imesaṃ na paṇḍakā, te pi paṇḍake dūsenti.
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.17: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū hatthibhaṇḍānaṃ assabhaṇḍānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.18: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.19: paṇḍako bhikkhave anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo, upasampanno nāsetabbo 'ti. ||2||61||
pli-tv-kd1:62.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro purāṇakulaputto khīṇakolañño sukhumālo hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:62.1.2: atha kho tassa purāṇakulaputtassa khīṇakolaññassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:62.1.3: ahaṃ kho sukhumālo na paṭibalo anadhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ adhigantuṃ adhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ phātikātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:62.1.4: kena nu kho ahaṃ upāyena sukhañ ca jīveyyaṃ na ca kilameyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:62.1.5: atha kho tassa purāṇakulaputtassa khīṇakolaññassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:62.1.6: ime kho samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā sukhasīlā sukhasamācārā subhojanāni bhuñjitvā nivātesu sayanesu sayanti.
pli-tv-kd1:62.1.7: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ sāmaṃ pattacīvaraṃ paṭiyādetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvaseyyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:62.2.1: atha kho so purāṇakulaputto khīṇakolañño sāmaṃ pattacīvaraṃ paṭiyādetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhū abhivādeti.
pli-tv-kd1:62.3.1: atha kho so purāṇakulaputto khīṇakolañño āyasmatā Upālinā anuyuñjiyamāno etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:62.3.2: āyasmā Upāli bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:62.3.4: theyyasaṃvāsako bhikkhave anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo, upasampanno nāsetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:62.3.5: titthiyapakkantako bhikkhave anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo, upasampanno nāsetabbo 'ti. ||3||62||
pli-tv-kd1:63.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro nāgo nāgayoniyā aṭṭiyati harāyati jigucchati.
pli-tv-kd1:63.1.2: atha kho tassa nāgassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:63.1.3: kena nu kho ahaṃ upāyena nāgayoniyā ca parimucceyyaṃ khippañ ca manussattaṃ paṭilabheyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:63.1.4: atha kho tassa nāgassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:63.1.5: ime kho samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā dhammacārino samacārino brahmacārino saccavādino sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā.
pli-tv-kd1:63.1.6: sace kho ahaṃ samaṇesu Sakyaputtiyesu pabbajeyyaṃ, evāhaṃ nāgayoniyā ca parimucceyyaṃ khippañ ca manussattaṃ paṭilabheyyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:63.2.1: atha kho so nāgo māṇavakavaṇṇena bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā pabbajjaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-kd1:63.2.3: tena kho pana samayena so nāgo aññatarena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ paccantime vihāre paṭivasati.
pli-tv-kd1:63.2.4: atha kho so bhikkhu rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya ajjhokāse caṅkamati.
pli-tv-kd1:63.2.5: atha kho so nāgo tassa bhikkhuno nikkhante vissaṭṭho niddaṃ okkami.
pli-tv-kd1:63.2.6: sabbo vihāro ahinā puṇṇo, vātapānehi bhogā nikkhantā honti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:63.3.1: atha kho so bhikkhu vihāraṃ pavisissāmīti kavāṭaṃ paṇāmento addasa sabbaṃ vihāraṃ ahinā puṇṇaṃ, vātapānehi bhoge nikkhante. disvāna bhīto vissaraṃ akāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:63.3.2: bhikkhū upadhāvitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:63.3.4: ayaṃ āvuso sabbo vihāro ahinā puṇṇo, vātapānehi bhogā nikkhantā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:63.3.5: atha kho so nāgo tena saddena paṭibujjhitvā sake āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:63.3.9: kissa pana tvaṃ āvuso evarūpaṃ akāsīti.
pli-tv-kd1:63.3.10: atha kho so nāgo bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:63.4.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā taṃ nāgaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd1:63.4.2: tumhe khv' attha nāgā avirūḷhidhammā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye.
pli-tv-kd1:63.4.3: gaccha tvaṃ nāga tatth' eva cātuddase pannarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa uposathaṃ upavasa, evaṃ tvaṃ nāgayoniyā ca parimuccissasi khippañ ca manussattaṃ paṭilabhissasīti.
pli-tv-kd1:63.4.4: atha kho so nāgo avirūḷhidhammo kirāhaṃ imasmiṃ dhammavinaye 'ti dukkhī dummano assūni pavattayamāno vissaraṃ karitvā pakkāmi. ||4||
pli-tv-kd1:63.5.3: yadā ca sajātiyā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevati, yadā ca vissaṭṭho niddaṃ okkamati.
pli-tv-kd1:63.5.4: ime kho bhikkhave dve paccayā nāgassa sabhāvapātukammāya.
pli-tv-kd1:63.5.5: tiracchānagato bhikkhave anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo, upasampanno nāsetabbo 'ti. ||5||63||
pli-tv-kd1:64.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro māṇavako mātaraṃ jīvitā voropesi.
pli-tv-kd1:64.1.2: so tena pāpakena kammena aṭṭiyati harāyati jigucchati.
pli-tv-kd1:64.1.3: atha kho tassa māṇavakassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:64.1.4: kena nu kho ahaṃ upāyena imassa pāpassa kammassa nikkhantiṃ kareyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:64.1.5: atha kho tassa māṇavakassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:64.1.6: ime kho samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā dhammacārino samacārino brahmacārino saccavādino sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā.
pli-tv-kd1:64.1.7: sace kho ahaṃ samaṇesu Sakyaputtiyesu pabbajeyyaṃ, evāhaṃ imassa pāpassa kammassa nikkhantiṃ kareyyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:64.2.1: atha kho so māṇavako bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā pabbajjaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-kd1:64.2.3: pubbe pi kho āvuso Upāli nāgo māṇavakavaṇṇena bhikkhūsu pabbajito,
pli-tv-kd1:64.2.5: atha kho so māṇavako āyasmatā Upālinā anuyuñjiyamāno etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:64.2.6: āyasmā Upāli bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:64.2.8: mātughātako bhikkhave anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo, upasampanno nāsetabbo 'ti. ||2||64||
pli-tv-kd1:65.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro māṇavako pitaraṃ jīvitā voropesi.
pli-tv-kd1:65.1.14: pitughātako bhikkhave anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo, upasampanno nāsetabbo 'ti. ||1||65||
pli-tv-kd1:66.1.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū Sāketā Sāvatthiṃ addhānamaggapaṭipannā honti.
pli-tv-kd1:66.1.2: antarā magge corā nikkhamitvā ekacce bhikkhū acchindiṃsu, ekacce bhikkhū haniṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:66.1.3: Sāvatthiyā rājabhaṭā nikkhamitvā ekacce core aggahesuṃ, ekacce corā palāyiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:66.1.4: ye te palāyiṃsu, te bhikkhūsu pabbajiṃsu, ye te gahitā, te vadhāya onīyanti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:66.2.1: addasaṃsu kho te pabbajitā te core vadhāya onīyamāne, disvāna evaṃ āhaṃsu:
pli-tv-kd1:66.2.2: sādhu kho mayaṃ palāyimhā, sacāca mayaṃ gayheyyāma, mayam pi evam eva haññeyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:66.2.5: atha kho te pabbajitā bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:66.2.8: arahantaghātako bhikkhave anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo, upasampanno nāsetabbo 'ti. ||2||66||
pli-tv-kd1:67.1.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhuniyo Sāketā Sāvatthiṃ addhānamaggapaṭipannā honti.
pli-tv-kd1:67.1.2: antarā magge corā nikkhamitvā ekaccā bhikkhuniyo acchindiṃsu, ekaccā bhikkhuniyo dūsesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:67.1.12: bhikkhunīdūsako bhikkhave anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo, upasampanno nāsetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:67.1.13: saṃghabhedako bhikkhave anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo, upasampanno nāsetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:67.1.14: lohituppādako bhikkhave anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo, upasampanno nāsetabbo 'ti. ||1||67||
pli-tv-kd1:68.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro ubhatovyañjanako bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:68.1.4: ubhatovyañjanako bhikkhave anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo, upasampanno nāsetabbo 'ti. ||1||68||
pli-tv-kd1:69.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū anupajjhāyakaṃ upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:69.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū saṃghena upajjhāyena upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:69.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū gaṇena upajjhāyena upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:69.4.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū paṇḍakupajjhāyena upasampādenti --gha--,
pli-tv-kd1:70.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū apattakaṃ upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:70.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū acīvarakaṃ upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:70.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū apattacīvarakaṃ upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:70.4.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū yācitakena pattena upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:70.5.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū yācitakena cīvarena upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:70.6.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū yācitakena pattacīvarena upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:70.6.8: yo upasampādeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassā 'ti. ||6||70|| naupasampādetabbakavīsativāraṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:71.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū hatthacchinnaṃ pabbājenti --gha--,
pli-tv-kd1:71.2.33: yo pabbājeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassā 'ti. ||2|| napabbājetabbadvattiṃsavāraṃ niṭṭhitaṃ. ||71|| dāyajjabhāṇavāraṃ niṭṭhitaṃ navamaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:72.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū alajjīnaṃ nissayaṃ denti.
pli-tv-kd1:72.1.5: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū alajjīnaṃ nissāya vasanti,
pli-tv-kd1:72.1.6: te pi na cirass' eva alajjino honti pāpabhikkhū.
pli-tv-kd1:72.1.12: na alajjīnaṃ nissayo dātabbo, na alajjīnaṃ nissāya vatthabban ti.
pli-tv-kd1:72.1.13: kathaṃ nu kho mayaṃ jāneyyāma lajjiṃ vā alajjiṃ vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:72.1.15: anujānāmi bhikkhave catūhapañcāhaṃ āgametuṃ yāva bhikkhusabhāgataṃ jānāmīti. ||2||72||
pli-tv-kd1:73.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu Kosalesu janapadesu addhānamaggapaṭipanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:73.1.2: atha kho tassa bhikkhuno etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:73.1.5: ahañ c' amhi nissayakaraṇīyo addhānamaggapaṭipanno. kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd1:73.1.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave addhānamaggapaṭipannena bhikkhunā nissayaṃ alabhamānena anissitena vatthun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:73.2.1: tena kho pana samayena dve bhikkhū Kosalesu janapadesu addhānamaggapaṭipannā honti,
pli-tv-kd1:73.2.4: atha kho tassa gilānassa bhikkhuno etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:73.2.7: ahañ c' amhi nissayakaraṇīyo gilāno. kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd1:73.2.9: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā nissayaṃ alabhamānena anissitena vatthun ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:73.3.1: atha kho tassa gilānupaṭṭhākassa bhikkhuno etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:73.3.4: ahañ c' amhi nissayakaraṇīyo, ayañ ca bhikkhu gilāno. kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd1:73.3.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānupaṭṭhākena bhikkhunā nissayaṃ alabhamānena yāciyamānena anissitena vatthun ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd1:73.4.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu araññe viharati,
pli-tv-kd1:73.4.2: tassa ca tasmiṃ senāsane phāsu hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:73.4.3: atha kho tassa bhikkhuno etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:73.4.6: ahañ c' amhi nissayakaraṇīyo, araññe viharāmi, mayhañ ca imasmiṃ senāsane phāsu hoti. kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd1:73.4.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave āraññakena bhikkhunā phāsuvihāraṃ sallakkhentena nissayaṃ alabhamānena anissitena vatthuṃ
pli-tv-kd1:73.4.9: yadā paṭirūpo nissayadāyako āgacchissati, tassa nissāya vasissāmīti. ||4||73||
pli-tv-kd1:74.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Mahākassapassa upasampadāpekkho hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:74.1.2: atha kho āyasmā Mahākassapo āyasmato Ānandassa santike dūtaṃ pāhesi:
pli-tv-kd1:74.1.5: nāhaṃ ussahāmi therassa nāmaṃ gahetuṃ, garu me thero 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:74.1.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave gottena pi anussāvetun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:74.2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Mahākassapassa dve upasampadāpekkhā honti,
pli-tv-kd1:74.2.3: ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ upasampajjissāmi, ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ upasampajjissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd1:74.2.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave dve ekānussāvane kātun ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:74.3.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ upasampadāpekkhā honti,
pli-tv-kd1:74.3.3: ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ upasampajjissāmi, ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ upasampajjissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd1:74.3.5: handa mayaṃ āvuso sabbeva ekānussāvane karomā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:74.3.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave dve tayo ekānussāvane kātuṃ, tañ ca kho ekena upajjhāyena, na tv eva nānupajjhāyenā 'ti. ||3||74||
pli-tv-kd1:75.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Kumārakassapo gabbhavīso upasampanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:75.1.2: atha kho āyasmato Kumārakassapassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:75.1.5: ahañ c' amhi gabbhavīso. upasampanno nu kho 'mhi na nu kho
pli-tv-kd1:75.1.8: yaṃ bhikkhave mātu kucchismiṃ paṭhamaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, paṭhamam viññāṇaṃ pātubhūtaṃ, tadupādāya sā 'v' assa jāti.
pli-tv-kd1:76.1.1: tena kho pana samayena upasampannā dissanti kuṭṭhikāpi gaṇḍikāpi kilāsikāpi sosikāpi apamārikāpi.
pli-tv-kd1:76.1.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave upasampādentena tassa antarāyike dhamme pucchituṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ananusiṭṭhe upasampadāpekkhe antarāyike dhamme pucchanti.
pli-tv-kd1:76.2.2: upasampadāpekkhā vitthāyanti, maṅkū honti, na sakkonti vissajjetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.2.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ anusāsitvā pacchā antarāyike dhamme pucchitun ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd1:76.3.2: upasampadāpekkhā tath' eva vitthāyanti, maṅkū honti, na sakkonti vissajjetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.3.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave ekamantaṃ anusāsitvā saṃghamajjhe antarāyike dhamme pucchituṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.3.8: ayan te patto, ayaṃ saṃghāṭi, ayaṃ uttarāsaṅgo, ayaṃ antaravāsako,
pli-tv-kd1:76.4.2: anusiṭṭhā upasampadāpekkhā vitthāyanti, maṅkū honti, na sakkonti vissajjetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.4.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena anusāsitun ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd1:76.5.7: attanā vā attānaṃ sammannitabbaṃ parena vā paro sammannitabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:76.5.8: kathañ ca attanā vā attānaṃ sammannitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.5.12: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, ahaṃ itthannāmaṃ anusāseyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:76.6.5: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, itthannāmo itthannāmaṃ anusāseyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd1:76.7.1: tena sammatena bhikkhunā upasampadāpekkho upasaṃkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd1:76.7.2: suṇasi itthannāma. ayaṃ te saccakālo bhūtakālo.
pli-tv-kd1:76.7.3: yaṃ jātaṃ taṃ saṃghamajjhe pucchante santaṃ atthīti vattabbaṃ, asantaṃ n' atthīti vattabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.7.4: mā kho vitthāsi, mā kho maṅku ahosi.
pli-tv-kd1:76.8.9: ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ kārāpetvā bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vandāpetvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīdāpetvā añjaliṃ paggaṇhāpetvā upasampadaṃ yācāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd1:76.8.11: ullumpatu maṃ bhante saṃgho anukampaṃ upādāya,
pli-tv-kd1:76.8.12: dutiyam pi bhante . . ., tatiyam pi bhante saṃghaṃ upasampadaṃ yācāmi,
pli-tv-kd1:76.8.13: ullumpatu maṃ bhante saṃgho anukampaṃ upādāyā
pli-tv-kd1:76.9.4: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, ahaṃ itthannāmaṃ antarāyike dhamme puccheyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd1:76.9.5: suṇasi itthannāma. ayaṃ te saccakālo bhūtakālo.
pli-tv-kd1:76.9.7: santaṃ atthīti vattabbaṃ, asantaṃ n' atthīti vattabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.10.3: ayaṃ itthannāmo itthannāmassa āyasmato upasampadāpekkho, parisuddho antarāyikehi dhammehi, paripuṇṇ' assa pattacīvaraṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.10.4: itthannāmo saṃghaṃ upasampadaṃ yācati itthannāmena upajjhāyena.
pli-tv-kd1:76.10.5: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ upasampādeyya itthannāmena upajjhāyena.
pli-tv-kd1:76.11.2: ayaṃ itthannāmo itthannāmassa āyasmato upasampadāpekkho, parisuddho antarāyikehi dhammehi, paripuṇṇ' assa pattacīvaraṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.11.3: itthannāmo saṃghaṃ upasampadaṃ yācati itthannāmena upajjhāyena.
pli-tv-kd1:76.11.5: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa upasampadā itthannāmena upajjhāyena, so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd1:76.12.16: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evam etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||12||76||
pli-tv-kd1:77.1.1: tāvad eva chāyā metabbā, utupamāṇaṃ ācikkhitabbaṃ, divasabhāgo ācikkhitabbo, saṃgīti ācikkhitabbā, cattāro nissayā ācikkhitabbā:
pli-tv-kd1:77.1.5: saṃghabhattaṃ uddesabhattaṃ nimantanaṃ salākabhattaṃ pakkhikaṃ uposathikaṃ pāṭipadikaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:77.1.9: khomaṃ kappāsikaṃ koseyyaṃ kambalaṃ sāṇaṃ bhaṅgaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:77.1.17: sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitan ti. ||1||77||
pli-tv-kd1:78.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ upasampādetvā ekakaṃ ohāya pakkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:78.1.2: so pacchā ekako āgacchanto antarā magge purāṇadutiyikāya samāgacchi.
pli-tv-kd1:78.1.8: so tassā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitvā cirena āgamāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:78.1.10: kissa tvaṃ āvuso evaṃ ciraṃ akāsīti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:78.2.1: atha kho so bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:78.2.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave upasampādetvā dutiyaṃ dātuṃ cattāri ca akaraṇīyāni ācikkhituṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:78.2.4: upasampannena bhikkhunā methuno dhammo na paṭisevitabbo antamaso tiracchānagatāya pi.
pli-tv-kd1:78.2.5: yo bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevati, assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo.
pli-tv-kd1:78.2.6: seyyathāpi nāma puriso sīsacchinno abhabbo tena sarīrabandhanena jīvituṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:78.2.7: evam eva bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo,
pli-tv-kd1:78.3.1: upasampannena bhikkhunā adinnaṃ theyyasaṃkhātaṃ na ādātabbaṃ antamaso tiṇasalākaṃ upādāya.
pli-tv-kd1:78.3.2: yo bhikkhu pādaṃ vā pādārahaṃ vā atirekapādaṃ vā adinnaṃ theyyasaṃkhātaṃ ādiyati, assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo.
pli-tv-kd1:78.3.3: seyyathāpi nāma paṇḍupalāso bandhanā pamutto abhabbo haritattāya,
pli-tv-kd1:78.3.4: evam eva bhikkhu pādaṃ vā pādārahaṃ vā atirekapādaṃ vā adinnaṃ theyyasaṃkhātaṃ ādiyitvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo,
pli-tv-kd1:78.4.1: upasampannena bhikkhunā sañcicca pāṇo jīvitā no voropetabbo antamaso kunthakipillikaṃ upādāya.
pli-tv-kd1:78.4.2: yo bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropeti antamaso gabbhapātanaṃ upādāya, assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo.
pli-tv-kd1:78.4.3: seyyathāpi nāma puthusilā dvedhā bhinnā appaṭisandhikā hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:78.4.4: evam eva bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropetvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo,
pli-tv-kd1:78.5.1: upasampannena bhikkhunā uttarimanussadhammo na ullapitabbo antamaso suññāgāre abhiramāmīti.
pli-tv-kd1:78.5.2: yo bhikkhu pāpiccho icchāpakato asantaṃ abhūtaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ ullapati jhānaṃ vā vimokkhaṃ vā samādhiṃ vā samāpattiṃ vā maggaṃ vā phalaṃ vā, assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo.
pli-tv-kd1:78.5.3: seyyathāpi nāma tālo matthakacchinno abhabbo punavirūḷhiyā,
pli-tv-kd1:78.5.4: evam eva bhikkhu pāpiccho icchāpakato asantaṃ abhūtaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ ullapitvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo,
pli-tv-kd1:79.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu āpattiyā adassane ukkhittako vibbhami,
pli-tv-kd1:79.1.2: so puna paccāgantvā bhikkhū upasampadaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-kd1:79.1.4: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu āpattiyā adassane ukkhittako vibbhamati,
pli-tv-kd1:79.1.5: so puna paccāgantvā bhikkhū upasampadaṃ yācati.
pli-tv-kd1:79.1.9: sac' āhaṃ na passissāmīti na pabbājetabbo. ||1||
pli-tv-kd1:79.1.13: sac' āhaṃ na passissāmīti na upasampādetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.2.4: sac' āhaṃ na passissāmīti na osāretabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.2.8: no ce passati, labbhamānāya sāmaggiyā puna ukkhipitabbo,
pli-tv-kd1:79.3.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu āpattiyā appaṭikamme ukkhittako vibbhamati,
pli-tv-kd1:79.3.2: so puna paccāgantvā bhikkhū upasampadaṃ yācati.
pli-tv-kd1:79.3.6: sac' āhaṃ na paṭikarissāmīti na pabbājetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.3.10: sac' āhaṃ na paṭikarissāmīti na upasampādetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.3.14: sac' āhaṃ na paṭikarissāmīti na osāretabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.3.18: no ce paṭikaroti, labbhamānāya sāmaggiyā puna ukkhipitabbo,
pli-tv-kd1:79.4.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhittako vibbhamati,
pli-tv-kd1:79.4.2: so puna paccāgantvā bhikkhū upasampadaṃ yācati.
pli-tv-kd1:79.4.6: sac' āhaṃ na paṭinissajjissāmīti na pabbājetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.4.10: sac' āhaṃ na paṭinissajjissāmīti na upasampādetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.4.14: sac' āhaṃ na paṭinissajjissāmīti na osāretabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.4.18: no ce paṭinissajjati, labbhamānāya sāmaggiyā puna ukkhipitabbo,
pli-tv-kd1:79.4.80: yo so añño ca, naggo ca,
pli-tv-kd1:79.4.130: imamhi khandhake vatthu ekasataṃ bāsattati. | Mahākhandhake uddānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ paṭhamaṃ.
